K-HEAL-01.title: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY health cover
K-HEAL-01.who_its_for: Poor and vulnerable families in the scheme list
K-HEAL-01.answer: Eligible families get cashless hospital treatment up to ₹5 lakh per family per year at listed public and private hospitals anywhere in India.
K-HEAL-01.steps: 1. Check eligibility on the beneficiary portal, Ayushman app or a hospital help desk. 2. Complete Aadhaar eKYC to get the Ayushman card. 3. Show the card at a listed hospital.
K-HEAL-01.documents: Aadhaar; ration card or family ID
K-HEAL-01.where_to_go: Beneficiary portal or Ayushman app; Arogya Mitra desk at listed hospitals; CSC
K-HEAL-01.check_note: ₹5 lakh cover confirmed in NHA documents

K-HEAL-02.title: Ayushman Vay Vandana card (age 70+)
K-HEAL-02.who_its_for: All citizens aged 70 and above, any income
K-HEAL-02.answer: Every person aged 70 or above gets free hospital treatment up to ₹5 lakh a year, whatever their income. If the family is already covered, the senior gets an extra ₹5 lakh just for themselves.
K-HEAL-02.steps: 1. Apply on the beneficiary portal or Ayushman app. 2. Complete Aadhaar eKYC. 3. Download the Vay Vandana card.
K-HEAL-02.check_note: NHA senior citizen FAQ; Rajya Sabha reply Feb 2025

K-HEAL-03.title: Is my treatment covered under PM-JAY?
K-HEAL-03.answer: Most hospital stays and surgeries at listed hospitals are covered, including costs a few days before and after admission. The Arogya Mitra desk at the hospital can confirm a specific treatment.
K-HEAL-03.where_to_go: Arogya Mitra desk at the hospital; helpline 14555
K-HEAL-03.check_note: Helpline 14555 confirmed; pre/post days not checked on an official page

K-HEAL-04.title: Find a hospital that accepts the Ayushman card
K-HEAL-04.answer: Ayushman card holders can get cashless treatment at any listed (empanelled) hospital anywhere in India. You can find the nearest listed hospital on the Ayushman app or hospital finder, or call 14555 for help.
K-HEAL-04.steps: 1. Open the hospital finder. 2. Choose state, district and specialty.
K-HEAL-04.where_to_go: Ayushman (PM-JAY) app or hospital finder; helpline 14555
K-HEAL-04.check_note: NHA confirms cashless treatment at any empanelled hospital in India (portability); PIB confirms 14555 helpline and hospital search via PM-JAY app.

K-HEAL-05.title: Free delivery care for pregnant women (JSSK)
K-HEAL-05.who_its_for: All pregnant women delivering in public hospitals, and sick newborns
K-HEAL-05.answer: Delivery, including caesarean, is free in government hospitals, along with medicines, tests, blood, food during the stay and transport from home and back. Sick newborns are also treated free.
K-HEAL-05.steps: 1. Register the pregnancy with the ASHA or health centre. 2. Go to a government hospital for delivery. 3. Call 108 or 102 for transport.
K-HEAL-05.where_to_go: Any government hospital or health centre
K-HEAL-05.check_note: NHM JSSK page; free diet 3 days normal / 7 days C-section

K-HEAL-06.title: Janani Suraksha Yojana cash help
K-HEAL-06.who_its_for: Pregnant women from poor families, SC and ST, delivering in a government or accredited hospital
K-HEAL-06.answer: Eligible mothers get cash help after delivering in a government or accredited hospital. Poor women who deliver at home can get ₹500. The amount for hospital delivery varies by state and rural or urban area.
K-HEAL-06.steps: 1. Register with the ASHA. 2. Deliver in a government or accredited hospital. 3. Money goes to the bank account.
K-HEAL-06.documents: Mother and child protection card; bank account; BPL or caste proof
K-HEAL-06.check_note: ₹500 home delivery confirmed (Lok Sabha reply); hospital amounts vary by state

K-HEAL-07.title: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (maternity money)
K-HEAL-07.who_its_for: Pregnant women and new mothers, except those in regular government jobs
K-HEAL-07.answer: Mothers get ₹5,000 for the first child in two instalments, and ₹6,000 for a second child if it is a girl, paid into their bank account.
K-HEAL-07.steps: 1. Register at the anganwadi or online. 2. Complete the check-ups and child registration needed for each instalment.
K-HEAL-07.documents: Aadhaar; bank account; mother and child protection card

K-HEAL-08.title: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (TB nutrition money)
K-HEAL-08.answer: Every TB patient on treatment gets ₹1,000 a month for food for the whole treatment period, paid to their bank account.
K-HEAL-08.steps: 1. Get registered on Ni-kshay at the health centre. 2. Give bank details. 3. Money comes monthly during treatment.

K-HEAL-09.title: Free TB tests and treatment
K-HEAL-09.who_its_for: Anyone with cough for 2 weeks or more, fever, night sweats or weight loss
K-HEAL-09.answer: TB tests and the full course of medicines are free at government health centres. Medicines must be taken every day for the full course, usually at least 6 months. Patients also get Rs 1,000 a month for nutrition during treatment under Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana.
K-HEAL-09.steps: 1. Visit a health centre for a free test. 2. Start treatment if positive. 3. Take medicines daily for the full course.
K-HEAL-09.fee_and_time: Free; at least 6 months, sometimes longer
K-HEAL-09.where_to_go: Primary health centre; district TB centre; Ni-kshay Sampark helpline 1800-11-6666
K-HEAL-09.check_note: PIB (Mar 2026) and TB Division FAQ: free TB tests and treatment at govt centres, treatment at least 6 months, Ni-kshay Poshan Rs 1,000/month, helpline 1800-11-6666.

K-HEAL-10.title: Child and pregnancy vaccinations (U-WIN)
K-HEAL-10.who_its_for: Children up to 16 years; pregnant women
K-HEAL-10.answer: All routine vaccines for pregnant women and children (birth to 16 years) are free at government centres, and can be taken anywhere in India. Each dose is recorded on U-WIN, which sends SMS reminders for the next dose and gives a QR e-vaccination certificate.
K-HEAL-10.steps: 1. Visit the health centre or village vaccination day. 2. Get the vaccine recorded. 3. Check due dates on U-WIN.
K-HEAL-10.documents: Mother and child protection card; mobile number
K-HEAL-10.where_to_go: Primary health centre; anganwadi; U-WIN portal
K-HEAL-10.check_note: PIB: U-WIN records vaccines for pregnant women and children 0–16; anytime-anywhere; e-certificate

K-HEAL-11.title: Get an ABHA health ID
K-HEAL-11.answer: ABHA is a free 14-digit digital health ID. Your health records are linked to it, and any hospital in the network can see them only with your consent. The ABHA app also lets you scan a QR code to register at hospitals and skip queues.
K-HEAL-11.steps: 1. Open the ABHA site or app. 2. Verify with Aadhaar or driving licence. 3. Download the ABHA card.
K-HEAL-11.where_to_go: ABHA website or app; hospital registration desk
K-HEAL-11.check_note: PIB: ABHA is a 14-digit health ID; records shared with consent

K-HEAL-12.title: Cheaper generic medicines at Jan Aushadhi Kendras
K-HEAL-12.answer: Jan Aushadhi Kendras sell quality generic medicines at least 50% cheaper than branded ones. The nearest Kendra can be found on the Janaushadhi Sugam app.
K-HEAL-12.steps: 1. Find a Kendra on the app or website. 2. Show your prescription.
K-HEAL-12.where_to_go: Jan Aushadhi Kendra; Janaushadhi Sugam app
K-HEAL-12.check_note: PIB fact sheet: at least 50% cheaper

K-HEAL-13.title: Free online doctor consultation (eSanjeevani)
K-HEAL-13.answer: Patients can talk to a government doctor by video for free and get an e-prescription, from a phone or at a health centre.
K-HEAL-13.steps: 1. Open the eSanjeevani app or site. 2. Register with mobile number. 3. Join the queue for a doctor.
K-HEAL-13.check_note: PIB: eSanjeevani is the free national telemedicine service

K-HEAL-14.title: Free health check for BP, diabetes and cancers
K-HEAL-14.answer: Adults 30 and above can get free screening for high blood pressure, diabetes and common cancers at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (health and wellness centres).
K-HEAL-14.where_to_go: Ayushman Arogya Mandir; primary health centre
K-HEAL-14.check_note: PIB: screening of 30+ for hypertension, diabetes, oral, breast and cervical cancer at Ayushman Arogya Mandirs

K-HEAL-15.title: Free dialysis
K-HEAL-15.who_its_for: Patients with kidney failure, especially poor families
K-HEAL-15.answer: Poor (BPL) patients get free dialysis at district hospitals under the PM National Dialysis Programme. Dialysis is also covered for Ayushman card holders.
K-HEAL-15.steps: 1. Get a referral from a government doctor. 2. Register at the district hospital dialysis unit.
K-HEAL-15.documents: BPL card or Ayushman card; doctor's referral
K-HEAL-15.check_note: PIB: PM National Dialysis Programme – free dialysis for BPL patients at district hospitals; also covered under PM-JAY

K-HEAL-16.title: Ambulance
K-HEAL-16.answer: Call 108 for a free emergency ambulance, called Arogya Kavacha in Karnataka. Pregnant women and sick infants can also use 102 for transport to hospital.
K-HEAL-16.check_note: Karnataka govt lists Ambulance 102/108 and Arogya Kavacha 108 free emergency service. Specific use of 102 for mothers and infants not stated on the page found.

K-HEAL-17.title: Health advice helpline
K-HEAL-17.answer: Call 104, Arogya Sahayavani, any time of day for free health advice, counselling, and information about government hospitals and blood banks. You can also raise complaints about government health services on this number.
K-HEAL-17.check_note: Karnataka NHM page: Arogya Sahayavani 104 toll-free, 24x7, gives advice on minor ailments, counselling, info on public health services, blood/eye bank directory, complaints.

K-HEAL-18.title: Mental health support (Tele-MANAS)
K-HEAL-18.answer: Tele-MANAS gives free, confidential mental health support by phone, 24 hours a day, in many languages.

K-HEAL-19.title: Birth and death certificates
K-HEAL-19.answer: Births and deaths should be registered within 21 days, and the certificate is free if reported in time. In Karnataka, hospitals and local registrars record them on e-Janma, and in Bengaluru the city's health officers are the registrars. Certificates can also be downloaded from Seva Sindhu for a small fee.
K-HEAL-19.steps: 1. The hospital, or the family for a home event, reports the birth or death. 2. The registrar records it on e-Janma. 3. Collect the certificate or download it from Seva Sindhu.
K-HEAL-19.fee_and_time: Free if reported within 21 days; late fee after. Seva Sindhu copy: Rs 5, plus Rs 20 at Grama One, Bangalore One or Karnataka One
K-HEAL-19.where_to_go: Hospital where the event happened; local registrar (village accountant in rural areas, health officer in towns and Bengaluru); Seva Sindhu portal
K-HEAL-19.check_note: CRS (RGI): report within 21 days, certificate free if reported in time, late fee after. Karnataka registers on e-Janma; Seva Sindhu certificate Rs 5 + Rs 20 service charge.

K-HEAL-20.title: Find blood in blood banks (e-RaktKosh)
K-HEAL-20.answer: You can check which nearby blood banks have the blood group you need on the e-RaktKosh website. It also lists blood banks and donation camps near you.
K-HEAL-20.check_note: e-RaktKosh (MoHFW) official site offers blood stock availability search, nearby blood bank directory and camp search across India.

K-HEAL-21.title: Free school health checks (RBSK)
K-HEAL-21.who_its_for: Children 0–18 in government and aided schools and anganwadis
K-HEAL-21.answer: Health teams check all children from birth to 18 years for birth defects, diseases, deficiencies and development delays, at anganwadis, schools and after delivery. Children found with these conditions get free treatment, including surgery.
K-HEAL-21.check_note: PIB: RBSK screens children 0–18 for 4Ds (defects, diseases, deficiencies, development delays); free treatment incl. surgery

K-HEAL-22.title: Pledge organ donation
K-HEAL-22.answer: Anyone aged 18 or above can pledge to donate organs after death on the NOTTO website, which verifies you through Aadhaar. Please tell your family about your wish, as their consent is still needed at the time.
K-HEAL-22.steps: 1. Open the NOTTO site. 2. Fill the pledge form and verify with the OTP sent to your Aadhaar-linked mobile. 3. Download your donor card and tell your family.
K-HEAL-22.documents: Aadhaar-linked mobile number (for online pledge); or a signed Form 7 by post
K-HEAL-22.check_note: NOTTO FAQ/booklet: pledge online (Aadhaar + OTP verified) or via Form 7; 18+ only; family consent still required. PIB confirms Aadhaar-based pledge portal since 2023.

K-EDU-01.title: RTE free seats in private schools (Karnataka rule)
K-EDU-01.who_its_for: Children from disadvantaged and weaker-section families
K-EDU-01.answer: The RTE Act reserves 25% of entry-level seats in private unaided schools for these children. In Karnataka, since 2019, a child can get an RTE seat in a private school only if there is no government or aided school in the neighbourhood.
K-EDU-01.steps: 1. Watch for the state RTE admission notice. 2. Apply online in the window. 3. Seats are given by lottery.
K-EDU-01.documents: Birth certificate; address proof; income or caste certificate
K-EDU-01.where_to_go: School Education Department RTE portal; block education office
K-EDU-01.check_note: 2019 Karnataka rule amendment, upheld by High Court; Supreme Court has asked states to enforce 25% — check current status before demos

K-EDU-02.title: Midday meals (PM POSHAN)
K-EDU-02.who_its_for: Children in Balvatika (pre-Class 1) and Classes 1–8 in government and aided schools
K-EDU-02.answer: Children get one free hot cooked meal on every school day. There is nothing to apply for.
K-EDU-02.check_note: PIB and Ministry of Education: Balvatika + Classes 1–8

K-EDU-03.title: Karnataka post-matric scholarships (SSP)
K-EDU-03.who_its_for: Karnataka students after Class 10 from SC, ST, backward classes, minorities and other eligible groups
K-EDU-03.answer: Karnataka students studying after Class 10 can apply on the State Scholarship Portal for fee and maintenance support from 13 departments. Income limits depend on the category, for example ₹2.5 lakh a year for SC and Category-I students.
K-EDU-03.steps: 1. Register on the SSP post-matric portal. 2. Fill the application with caste and income details. 3. College verifies. 4. Money goes to the Aadhaar-linked bank account.
K-EDU-03.documents: Aadhaar; caste and income certificate; marks card; fee receipt; bank account
K-EDU-03.check_note: Portal and 13 departments confirmed via secondary sources; check income limits per category on SSP

K-EDU-04.title: Vidyasiri food and hostel help (Karnataka)
K-EDU-04.who_its_for: Backward-class post-matric students who do not get a government hostel seat
K-EDU-04.answer: Eligible students who can't get a government hostel seat get monthly help for food and stay, applied through the SSP portal.
K-EDU-04.steps: 1. Apply on SSP. 2. Meet attendance and marks rules.
K-EDU-04.documents: Caste and income certificate; admission proof; bank account
K-EDU-04.check_note: Listed on myScheme; amount not checked on an official page

K-EDU-05.title: National scholarships (NSP)
K-EDU-05.who_its_for: Students from minority, SC, ST, OBC and other groups, and merit students, across India
K-EDU-05.answer: Central government scholarships for school and college students are applied for on the National Scholarship Portal. First get a free One Time Registration number, then apply for the scheme that fits you.
K-EDU-05.steps: 1. Get a One Time Registration (OTR) number on NSP with your mobile number and face authentication on the NSP OTR app. 2. Log in and apply for the scheme when it is open. 3. Your institute, then the district or state officer, verify the application.
K-EDU-05.documents: Aadhaar; income certificate; marks; bank account
K-EDU-05.fee_and_time: Free to apply (no fee for OTR or the application)
K-EDU-05.check_note: NSP pages: One Time Registration (OTR) is mandatory, free, needs mobile + face authentication; portal open for AY 2026-27 from 1 Jun 2026.

K-EDU-06.title: When is the scholarship deadline?
K-EDU-06.answer: Deadlines change every year and differ by scheme. The agent should say: please check the latest notice on the SSP or NSP portal, or ask your college scholarship desk.

K-EDU-07.title: What age should my child be for Class 1?
K-EDU-07.answer: The Ministry of Education has asked all states to admit children to Class 1 at 6 years or older. For the exact cut-off date in Karnataka, check the latest admission circular or ask the school.
K-EDU-07.check_note: MoE directed States/UTs to admit to Grade 1 at 6+ years (PIB/DoSEL). Karnataka's current cut-off date not confirmed on an official page.

K-EDU-08.title: Admission to a government school
K-EDU-08.answer: Schooling in government schools is free, and every child aged 6 to 14 has a right to free education. Visit the nearest government school with the child's documents to enrol.
K-EDU-08.steps: 1. Visit the school. 2. Fill the admission form.
K-EDU-08.documents: Birth certificate; Aadhaar if available; transfer certificate if changing school
K-EDU-08.check_note: RTE Act gives free, compulsory schooling for ages 6-14 (PIB). 'Admission through the year' not confirmed on an official Karnataka page.

K-EDU-09.title: Free textbooks and uniforms
K-EDU-09.answer: Under Samagra Shiksha, children in Classes 1 to 8 in government schools get free textbooks, and free uniforms go to girls and to SC, ST and BPL boys. The state may give more, so ask the school what your child gets.
K-EDU-09.check_note: Samagra Shiksha (PIB): free textbooks for all children and free uniforms for girls, SC, ST and BPL boys, at elementary level. Not 'all children' for uniforms.

K-EDU-10.title: Transfer certificate
K-EDU-10.answer: Ask the head teacher for a transfer certificate. In Karnataka, schools issue it through the state's SATS student system.
K-EDU-10.steps: 1. Apply to the head teacher. 2. Collect the certificate.
K-EDU-10.fee_and_time: Free in government schools; a few days
K-EDU-10.check_note: Karnataka schools issue TCs through the SATS student system (sts.karnataka.gov.in manuals). 'Free' and timeline not confirmed on an official page.

K-EDU-11.title: SSLC and PUC results and marks card copies (Karnataka)
K-EDU-11.answer: Board results are published online. Duplicate marks cards and revaluation can be applied for with the board within the notified dates.
K-EDU-11.steps: 1. Check results on the KSEAB results page with the register number. 2. Within the notified dates, apply online for a scanned copy, retotalling or revaluation. 3. Apply online on the KSEAB site for a duplicate marks card.
K-EDU-11.where_to_go: Karnataka School Examination and Assessment Board
K-EDU-11.check_note: KSEAB site lists online services: results, duplicate marks cards, scanned copy, retotalling, revaluation; SSLC duplicate marks card is a Sakala service.

K-EDU-12.title: Get your certificates on DigiLocker
K-EDU-12.answer: Class 10 and 12 marks cards and many university certificates can be downloaded free on DigiLocker, if your board or university has uploaded them. Documents in the Issued section are treated the same as originals.
K-EDU-12.steps: 1. Sign in to DigiLocker. 2. Search your board or university. 3. Fetch the document.
K-EDU-12.check_note: DigiLocker: issued documents are at par with originals under Rule 9A; marks cards appear only if the board or university has uploaded them.

K-EDU-13.title: PM Vidyalaxmi education loan
K-EDU-13.who_its_for: Students admitted to top-ranked higher education institutions
K-EDU-13.answer: Students who get admission on merit to listed top institutions can get education loans with no collateral or guarantor through the PM Vidyalaxmi portal. Families earning up to Rs 8 lakh a year get 3 percent interest help on loans up to Rs 10 lakh.
K-EDU-13.steps: 1. Apply on the Vidyalaxmi portal. 2. Choose banks. 3. Track the application.
K-EDU-13.check_note: PIB: collateral- and guarantor-free loans for merit admission to listed QHEIs; 3% interest subvention on loans up to Rs 10 lakh for family income up to Rs 8 lakh.

K-EDU-14.title: Free coaching and online courses (SWAYAM)
K-EDU-14.answer: Free online courses from top Indian universities are available on SWAYAM, some with credit.
K-EDU-14.check_note: SWAYAM FAQ and PIB: courses free; certificate needs a proctored exam with a nominal fee; credit transfer allowed under UGC/AICTE rules.

K-EDU-15.title: Scholarship for girls (single girl child)
K-EDU-15.who_its_for: Girl students who are the only child
K-EDU-15.answer: CBSE has a merit scholarship for girls who are their parents' only child, passed CBSE Class 10 with at least 70 percent and study in Class 11 or 12 at a CBSE school. Apply on the CBSE website when it opens; for other girls' scholarships, check NSP and SSP.
K-EDU-15.check_note: CBSE runs a Merit Scholarship for Single Girl Child (only child, CBSE Class 10 with 70%+, in Class 11-12), applied on cbse.gov.in, not NSP.

K-EDU-16.title: Hostel admission (Karnataka welfare hostels)
K-EDU-16.who_its_for: Students from SC, ST, backward classes and minorities
K-EDU-16.answer: Karnataka's welfare departments run free hostels for SC, ST, backward class and minority students. Apply online on the State Hostel Portal in the notified window; you need an SSP student account first.
K-EDU-16.steps: 1. Create an SSP student account. 2. Apply on the State Hostel Portal in the notified window. 3. Selection is by the department's rules on merit, category and income.
K-EDU-16.documents: Caste and income certificate; previous marks card; photo; distance certificate if asked
K-EDU-16.check_note: Applications go through Karnataka's State Hostel Portal (shp.karnataka.gov.in), which needs an SSP student account; docs per Seva Sindhu minority hostel page.

K-EDU-17.title: My scholarship money hasn't come
K-EDU-17.answer: Karnataka pays scholarships only into the bank account linked to the student's Aadhaar in the NPCI system, so the usual reason is that no account is Aadhaar-seeded or the account is inactive. Also check that the college has verified the application, and track the status on SSP or NSP.
K-EDU-17.steps: 1. Track payment status on SSP or NSP. 2. Check which bank account is Aadhaar-seeded using the portal link, and visit the bank if needed. 3. Ask the college scholarship desk to confirm verification.
K-EDU-17.where_to_go: SSP/NSP portal; college desk; bank branch
K-EDU-17.check_note: SSP 'About': payment is DBT only to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account fetched from NPCI; bank account number not entered on SSP.

K-EDU-18.title: Exam schedule announcement
K-EDU-18.answer: Board exam dates are announced by the examination board. The agent should read out only the dates in the current official notice.

K-EDU-19.title: Adult literacy (ULLAS)
K-EDU-19.who_its_for: Adults aged 15+ who can't read or write
K-EDU-19.answer: Adults can learn to read, write and do basic maths free through the ULLAS programme, with volunteer teachers and an app.
K-EDU-19.check_note: PIB: ULLAS (Nav Bharat Saaksharta Karyakram) for non-literates aged 15+, volunteer-based, with ULLAS app; scheme period FY 2022-27.

K-EDU-20.title: Apprenticeships for graduates and diploma holders
K-EDU-20.answer: Recent graduates and diploma holders can find paid apprenticeships on the NATS portal. The minimum stipend is Rs 9,000 a month for graduates and Rs 8,000 for diploma holders, with part paid by the government straight to the bank.
K-EDU-20.steps: 1. Register on the portal. 2. Apply to openings.
K-EDU-20.check_note: PIB: NATS (MoE) for graduates/diploma holders; minimum stipend Rs 9,000/8,000 a month, govt pays 50% via DBT; NATS 2.0 portal. Scheme approved to 2025-26.

K-AGRI-01.title: PM-KISAN income support
K-AGRI-01.who_its_for: Land-owning farmer families (income-tax payers, government employees and some others excluded)
K-AGRI-01.answer: Eligible farmer families get ₹6,000 a year in three instalments of ₹2,000, paid straight into their bank account.
K-AGRI-01.steps: 1. Register on the PM-KISAN portal, at a CSC or at the agriculture office. 2. Complete eKYC. 3. Keep land records and the Aadhaar-linked bank account correct.
K-AGRI-01.where_to_go: PM-KISAN portal; CSC; Raitha Samparka Kendra

K-AGRI-02.title: Why didn't my PM-KISAN instalment come?
K-AGRI-02.answer: The most common reasons are eKYC not done, Aadhaar not linked to the bank account, or land records not yet verified. The status can be checked on the PM-KISAN portal under 'Know your status'.
K-AGRI-02.steps: 1. Check status online. 2. Complete eKYC if pending. 3. Visit the agriculture office if land verification is pending.
K-AGRI-02.check_note: PIB: 'Know Your Status' module shows payment, eligibility, land seeding, Aadhaar linking and eKYC status; benefits need land seeding + Aadhaar-seeded bank + eKYC

K-AGRI-03.title: PM-KISAN eKYC
K-AGRI-03.answer: eKYC is required to keep getting PM-KISAN money. It can be done three ways: with an Aadhaar OTP on the portal, by fingerprint at a CSC, or by face scan on the PM-KISAN app at home — no OTP or fingerprint needed.
K-AGRI-03.steps: 1. Open the portal or app. 2. Choose eKYC. 3. Verify with OTP, face or fingerprint.
K-AGRI-03.fee_and_time: Free online; small fee at CSC
K-AGRI-03.check_note: PIB: eKYC by OTP, biometric (CSC) or face authentication on the PM-KISAN app

K-AGRI-04.title: Crop insurance (PMFBY)
K-AGRI-04.who_its_for: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas, including tenant farmers
K-AGRI-04.answer: Crops are insured against loss from drought, flood, pests and other natural causes. Farmers pay a small share of the premium: up to 2% for kharif crops, 1.5% for rabi crops and 5% for commercial and horticulture crops.
K-AGRI-04.steps: 1. Enrol before the season's cut-off date through a bank, CSC, insurance agent or the portal. 2. Keep the receipt.
K-AGRI-04.documents: Aadhaar; land record or tenancy/sowing certificate; bank account
K-AGRI-04.check_note: 72-hour rule confirmed in PMFBY guidelines; premium shares well documented

K-AGRI-05.title: How do I report crop loss for insurance?
K-AGRI-05.answer: Report the loss within 72 hours of the event, through the Crop Insurance app, the insurance company's toll-free number, the bank or the agriculture office. Give the survey number, crop and area affected.
K-AGRI-05.steps: 1. Report within 72 hours. 2. Give survey number, crop and area. 3. Keep the complaint number.
K-AGRI-05.where_to_go: Crop Insurance app; insurer helpline; bank; agriculture office

K-AGRI-06.title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
K-AGRI-06.who_its_for: Farmers, including tenant farmers, sharecroppers, fishers and animal farmers
K-AGRI-06.answer: KCC gives short-term farm loans at 7% interest. Farmers who repay on time get a 3% incentive, so they pay only 4%. Loans up to ₹2 lakh need no collateral, and the limit under the interest scheme is now ₹5 lakh.
K-AGRI-06.steps: 1. Apply at any bank branch or through the PM-KISAN portal form. 2. Bank checks land and crop details.
K-AGRI-06.check_note: PIB: 7% rate, 3% prompt repayment, ₹2 lakh collateral-free, ₹5 lakh limit (Budget 2025-26)

K-AGRI-07.title: Soil testing and soil health card
K-AGRI-07.answer: Farmers can get their soil tested to learn which nutrients and fertilisers their field needs. Results come on a soil health card.
K-AGRI-07.steps: 1. Give a soil sample at the agriculture office or soil lab. 2. Collect the card with recommendations.
K-AGRI-07.where_to_go: Raitha Samparka Kendra; soil testing lab
K-AGRI-07.check_note: PIB: Soil Health Card scheme confirmed; costs not checked

K-AGRI-08.title: Check mandi prices and sell online (e-NAM)
K-AGRI-08.answer: Daily prices in regulated markets can be checked on the e-NAM app, and registered farmers can sell online across markets.
K-AGRI-08.check_note: PIB: 1,410 mandis on e-NAM across 23 states and 4 UTs (Dec 2024)

K-AGRI-09.title: Kisan Call Centre
K-AGRI-09.answer: Farmers can call 1800-180-1551 free for advice on crops, pests, weather and schemes in their own language. Lines are open from 6 am to 10 pm, every day.
K-AGRI-09.fee_and_time: Free; 6 am to 10 pm, all days
K-AGRI-09.check_note: mKisan and PIB: toll-free 1800-180-1551, replies in 22 languages, 6 am to 10 pm all seven days; covers crops, schemes, weather and market advice.

K-AGRI-10.title: Seasonal sowing and weather advisory
K-AGRI-10.answer: The agriculture department and weather services issue advice on what to sow, when, and which varieties suit the rainfall. The agent should read only the current advisory.
K-AGRI-10.where_to_go: Kisan Call Centre; agriculture office; Meghdoot app

K-AGRI-11.title: PM-KUSUM solar pumps
K-AGRI-11.answer: Farmers can get help to install standalone solar pumps or solarise existing grid pumps. The central government pays 30% of the benchmark cost; the state may add its share, and the farmer pays the rest (up to 70% if the state adds nothing). Applications go through the state nodal agency.
K-AGRI-11.steps: 1. Apply on the state nodal agency portal when applications open. 2. Pay farmer share. 3. Pump installed by a listed vendor.
K-AGRI-11.check_note: PIB: 30% central assistance for standalone and solarised pumps (50% in NE/hill states); farmer pays the rest if state gives no share

K-AGRI-12.title: Drip and sprinkler irrigation subsidy
K-AGRI-12.answer: Farmers get help to install drip and sprinkler systems: 55% of the cost for small and marginal farmers and 45% for others, for up to 5 hectares. Some states, including Karnataka, add extra top-up subsidy.
K-AGRI-12.steps: 1. Apply to the department. 2. Install through a registered company. 3. Subsidy released after inspection.
K-AGRI-12.check_note: PIB: Per Drop More Crop – 55% assistance for small/marginal farmers, 45% for others, up to 5 ha; states may top up

K-AGRI-13.title: Farm machinery on subsidy and hire
K-AGRI-13.answer: Farmers can buy farm machines on subsidy, or hire them at low rates from hobli-level custom hiring centres, called Krushi Yantra Dhare in Karnataka.
K-AGRI-13.where_to_go: Raitha Samparka Kendra; Krushi Yantra Dhare (custom hiring centre)
K-AGRI-13.check_note: SMAM guidelines (rev. Aug 2026) confirm machinery subsidy and custom hiring centres; Karnataka runs hobli-level Krushi Yantra Dhare centres. Documents not confirmed.

K-AGRI-14.title: Subsidised seeds
K-AGRI-14.answer: Certified seeds of major crops are sold at subsidised rates at the Raitha Samparka Kendra at the start of each sowing season.
K-AGRI-14.check_note: Karnataka govt: certified seeds distributed on subsidy (Seed Mission, 50%) mainly via Raitha Samparka Kendras; KSDA issues seasonal subsidy circulars. Current rate and documents not confirmed.

K-AGRI-15.title: Farmer registration (FRUITS, Karnataka)
K-AGRI-15.answer: Karnataka farmers register once on FRUITS and get a farmer ID, which is used for most farm benefits and crop loss relief. You can register at the Raitha Samparka Kendra, the taluk horticulture office, or online yourself.
K-AGRI-15.steps: 1. Register at the Raitha Samparka Kendra or taluk horticulture office, or online through Citizen login on the FRUITS site. 2. Add your land survey numbers.
K-AGRI-15.where_to_go: Raitha Samparka Kendra; taluk horticulture office; FRUITS portal
K-AGRI-15.check_note: FRUITS FAQ: register at Raitha Samparka Kendra, taluk horticulture office, or self via Citizen login; land records (RTC) needed; ID records all benefits; Parihara uses FID.

K-AGRI-16.title: Animal health and vaccination
K-AGRI-16.answer: Vaccination against foot-and-mouth disease for cattle, buffaloes, sheep, goats and pigs is free under the national programme, and female calves aged 4 to 8 months get a free brucellosis vaccine. Veterinary hospitals treat animals at low cost.
K-AGRI-16.check_note: DAHD/PIB: NADCP gives 100% centrally funded FMD vaccination for cattle, buffalo, sheep, goat, pig and brucellosis vaccine for female calves 4-8 months. Low-cost vet treatment not checked.

K-AGRI-17.title: Fishers' support (PM Matsya Sampada)
K-AGRI-17.answer: Fishers and fish farmers can get help for boats, ponds, cold storage and insurance under PM Matsya Sampada Yojana, and Kisan Credit Cards for working capital. The help covers up to 40 percent of the cost, or 60 percent for SC, ST and women applicants.
K-AGRI-17.fee_and_time: Up to 40% of unit cost (60% for SC/ST and women)
K-AGRI-17.check_note: PIB/DoF: PMMSY aid up to 40% of unit cost (60% SC/ST/women) for ponds, boats, cold storage; insurance support; KCC for fishers. Rs 2,500 cr allocated for 2026-27.

K-AGRI-18.title: Crop survey and sowing details
K-AGRI-18.answer: Crop details for each survey number are recorded every season through the crop survey, and farmers can upload their own crop details on the Farmers Crop Survey app. You can check your record and raise an objection on the Bele Darshak app. Correct records matter for insurance and relief.
K-AGRI-18.where_to_go: Farmers Crop Survey app; Bele Darshak app; village accountant
K-AGRI-18.check_note: Karnataka Crop Survey site and karnataka.gov.in: crop details recorded per survey number each season via app, used for Parihara, RTC, insurance; Bele Darshak app to view and object.

K-AGRI-19.title: Farmer pension (PM Kisan Maandhan)
K-AGRI-19.answer: Farmers who pay a small monthly amount until 60 get a pension of ₹3,000 a month after 60. The government matches the farmer's contribution.
K-AGRI-19.steps: 1. Enrol at a CSC with Aadhaar and bank details. 2. Monthly contribution auto-debited.
K-AGRI-19.check_note: PIB: entry age 18–40, ₹55–200/month, matching central contribution, ₹3,000/month from 60; spouse can join separately

K-AGRI-20.title: Weather forecast for farmers (Meghdoot)
K-AGRI-20.answer: The free Meghdoot app gives weather forecasts for the next 5 days for your district and block, and crop advice twice a week in your language. Weather-based advice is also sent by SMS.
K-AGRI-20.check_note: IMD/PIB: Meghdoot app gives district and block 5-day forecasts and crop/livestock advisories every Tuesday and Friday in local languages; advisories also sent by SMS.

K-AGRI-21.title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund
K-AGRI-21.answer: Loans for warehouses, cold storage, sorting and processing units get 3% interest subvention per year on loans up to ₹2 crore, plus credit guarantee.
K-AGRI-21.steps: 1. Apply on the AIF portal. 2. Bank appraises the project.
K-AGRI-21.check_note: PIB: 3% interest subvention up to ₹2 crore loan

K-POWE-01.title: Gruha Jyothi free electricity (Karnataka)
K-POWE-01.who_its_for: Household electricity users in Karnataka (one meter per home)
K-POWE-01.answer: Each eligible home gets free electricity up to its past one-year average use plus 10%, up to a maximum of 200 units a month. Use above the limit is billed.
K-POWE-01.steps: 1. Register once on the Seva Sindhu guarantee portal with the electricity account ID. 2. Free units apply on the next bills.
K-POWE-01.where_to_go: Seva Sindhu guarantee portal; electricity office
K-POWE-01.check_note: Karnataka CM office: average + 10%; Seva Sindhu: up to 200 units

K-POWE-02.title: Why did I get a bill under Gruha Jyothi?
K-POWE-02.answer: If a home uses more than its eligible free units (average plus 10%), the extra units are billed. Homes using more than 200 units pay the full bill.

K-POWE-03.title: PM Surya Ghar rooftop solar subsidy
K-POWE-03.answer: Households get a central subsidy to put solar panels on their roof: ₹30,000 for 1 kW, ₹60,000 for 2 kW and ₹78,000 for 3 kW or more. A 3 kW system can make over 300 units a month. Low-interest loans are available.
K-POWE-03.steps: 1. Register on the national portal. 2. Pick a registered vendor. 3. Install and get the net meter. 4. Subsidy goes to the bank account.

K-POWE-04.title: New electricity connection
K-POWE-04.answer: In Bengaluru (BESCOM), apply online under Janasnehi Vidyuth Sevegalu. For homes and shops up to 17.5 kW where no new line is needed, power is given within 24 hours of paying the fees.
K-POWE-04.steps: 1. Apply online with documents (don't upload Aadhaar). 2. Pay charges. 3. Meter installed.
K-POWE-04.documents: ID (PAN, licence, passport or voter ID); ownership proof (sale deed, khata or tax receipt); geo-tagged building photo; wiring completion report
K-POWE-04.check_note: BESCOM: online under Janasnehi Vidyuth Sevegalu; supply within 24 hrs after fees for domestic/commercial ≤17.5 kW with no line extension; don't upload Aadhaar

K-POWE-05.title: Why is my electricity bill high?
K-POWE-05.answer: High bills usually come from more use (for example summer cooling), a meter reading error or a tariff change. A meter re-check can be requested.
K-POWE-05.steps: 1. Compare units with past months. 2. Check the reading on the bill. 3. Call 1912 if it looks wrong.
K-POWE-05.check_note: BESCOM 1912 and WhatsApp confirmed; bill-check advice is general

K-POWE-06.title: Report a power cut, line fault or fallen wire
K-POWE-06.answer: Call 1912 (24×7) or WhatsApp 9449844640 to report an outage or line fault. For dangers like fallen wires or sparking poles, use the safety WhatsApp 9483191212 and keep everyone away.
K-POWE-06.steps: 1. Call 1912. 2. Give account ID and location. 3. Note the complaint number.
K-POWE-06.check_note: BESCOM: 24×7 helpline 1912; WhatsApp 9449844640; safety WhatsApp 9483191212; BESCOM Mithra app

K-POWE-07.title: Pay the electricity bill
K-POWE-07.answer: Bills can be paid online on the electricity company website or app, through UPI apps, or at payment counters.
K-POWE-07.check_note: BESCOM Mithra app confirmed; payment channels general

K-POWE-08.title: Name change on electricity connection
K-POWE-08.answer: In Bengaluru, apply online for a name change (change of ownership) under Janasnehi Vidyuth Sevegalu. BESCOM completes it within 24 hours once documents are in order.
K-POWE-08.steps: 1. Apply online or at the office. 2. Submit documents. 3. Pay fee.
K-POWE-08.documents: Sale deed or legal heir certificate; ID; last bill
K-POWE-08.check_note: BESCOM: name change under Janasnehi Vidyuth Sevegalu, done within 24 hours

K-POWE-09.title: Load change
K-POWE-09.answer: Apply online to increase or reduce the sanctioned load. BESCOM completes it within 24 hours once documents and fees are in order.

K-POWE-10.title: Planned power cut notice
K-POWE-10.answer: Planned outages for maintenance are announced by the electricity company with area and timing. The agent should read only the current notice.

K-POWE-11.title: Free power for irrigation pumpsets
K-POWE-11.answer: Farmers with registered irrigation pumpsets (up to 10 HP) get free power supply from the state.
K-POWE-11.check_note: Energy Dept orders reference subsidy for pumpsets up to 10 HP

K-POWE-12.title: New water connection
K-POWE-12.who_its_for: Home owners in towns and cities
K-POWE-12.answer: In Bengaluru, apply to BWSSB for a new water connection. Call 1916 for help with the process.
K-POWE-12.steps: 1. Apply with documents. 2. Site inspection. 3. Pay fees. 4. Connection given.
K-POWE-12.where_to_go: City water board or municipal office
K-POWE-12.check_note: BWSSB contacts confirmed (1916); application steps not checked

K-POWE-13.title: No water supply in my area
K-POWE-13.answer: In Bengaluru, call BWSSB on 1916 (24×7) or WhatsApp 8762228888 to report no water supply. They can tell you the reason and when it will return.

K-POWE-14.title: Tap water for every rural home (Jal Jeevan Mission)
K-POWE-14.answer: Under Jal Jeevan Mission, every rural home is meant to get a working tap with safe drinking water. The mission now runs until December 2028. If your home has no tap or it doesn't work, tell your gram panchayat.
K-POWE-14.fee_and_time: Ask the gram panchayat about any charges
K-POWE-14.where_to_go: Gram panchayat; rural water supply department
K-POWE-14.check_note: JJM aim of a functional tap for every rural home confirmed (JJM site, PIB). Mission extended to Dec 2028. 'Free connection' not confirmed on an official page.

K-POWE-15.title: Report water leakage or contamination
K-POWE-15.answer: In Bengaluru, report leakage or dirty water to BWSSB on 1916 or WhatsApp 8762228888, with the exact location.

K-POWE-16.title: Electricity consumer grievance forum
K-POWE-16.who_its_for: Consumers unhappy with a complaint outcome
K-POWE-16.answer: If BESCOM hasn't solved your complaint, you can take it to BESCOM's Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum. If you are still not happy with its decision, you can appeal to the Electricity Ombudsman in Bengaluru.
K-POWE-16.steps: 1. Complain on 1912 and keep the complaint number. 2. If not solved, raise it at the monthly Customer Interaction Meeting at your BESCOM sub-division (3rd Saturday, 3 to 5.30 pm) or file with BESCOM's CGRF. 3. If unhappy with the CGRF order, appeal to the Electricity Ombudsman.
K-POWE-16.where_to_go: BESCOM CGRF; then Electricity Ombudsman, No. 16, C-1, Miller Tank Bed Area, Vasanth Nagar, Bengaluru 560052 (080-41692617)
K-POWE-16.check_note: BESCOM CGRF page, KERC CGRF & Ombudsman Regulations, BESCOM CIM page (3rd Saturday). Ombudsman address from CESC official page.

K-POWE-17.title: Electrical safety in rain
K-POWE-17.answer: Don't touch electric poles or wet switches, keep away from fallen wires, and switch off the main if water gets into the house. In Bengaluru, report hazards to BESCOM on 1912, any time.
K-POWE-17.where_to_go: BESCOM 1912; WhatsApp for safety issues 9483191212 or 9483191222
K-POWE-17.check_note: BESCOM Contact Us page confirms 1912 (24x7) and WhatsApp numbers for safety issues. The safety tips themselves are not listed on an official page found.

K-POWE-19.title: Apply for an EV charging connection
K-POWE-19.answer: BESCOM has a separate tariff for EV charging stations, and you can apply for a connection online on the BESCOM website or at your sub-division office. For home charging, ask BESCOM on 1912 which option fits.
K-POWE-19.fee_and_time: As per KERC tariff (EV charging stations: LT-6(c))
K-POWE-19.check_note: BESCOM EV pages confirm KERC tariff LT-6(c) for EV charging stations and online new connections on bescom.co.in. Home charging rules not confirmed.

K-POWE-20.title: Sewage connection
K-POWE-20.answer: In Bengaluru, sewage connections are given by BWSSB (call 1916). For safe cleaning of septic tanks or sewers, call 14420 — never send anyone into a sewer.
K-POWE-20.check_note: BWSSB: 1916; septic tank / sewer cleaning helpline 14420

K-MUNI-01.title: Pay property tax
K-MUNI-01.who_its_for: Property owners in cities and towns
K-MUNI-01.answer: In Bengaluru, property tax is paid online on the property tax portal under self-assessment. For 2026–27, the early-payment rebate ran 1–30 April 2026. Penalty starts on 29 November 2026 and second-half interest from 1 December 2026, so pay before then.
K-MUNI-01.steps: 1. Find the property ID. 2. Pay online or at the counter. 3. Keep the receipt.
K-MUNI-01.where_to_go: City corporation website or municipal office
K-MUNI-01.check_note: Bengaluru property tax portal: AY 2026–27 rebate 1–30 Apr 2026; first-half interest from 1 Jun; penalty from 29 Nov 2026; second-half interest from 1 Dec 2026

K-MUNI-02.title: When is property tax due?
K-MUNI-02.answer: Property tax is yearly. Each city sets the rebate period and due dates at the start of the financial year; the agent should read them from the current notice.
K-MUNI-02.check_note: Process card; Bengaluru dates in K-MUNI-01

K-MUNI-03.title: Property record (e-Khata / e-Aasthi)
K-MUNI-03.answer: In Bengaluru, property records (e-Khata) are applied for and downloaded online on the e-Aasthi portal. For help, call the GBA eKhata helpline 9480683695.
K-MUNI-03.steps: 1. Apply online with documents. 2. Verification. 3. Download e-khata.

K-MUNI-04.title: Rural property record (e-Swathu)
K-MUNI-04.answer: Village house and site records are kept online on e-Swathu by the gram panchayat. The panchayat issues Form 9, 11A or 11B from it, which you need to register or sell the property.
K-MUNI-04.check_note: RDPR e-Swathu page and Bapuji Seva Kendra portal: GPs issue Form 9/11A/11B via e-Swathu; needed for property registration (IGR).

K-MUNI-05.title: Trade licence
K-MUNI-05.answer: In Bengaluru, shops and businesses need a trade licence from the Greater Bengaluru Authority. You can apply or renew online, and the licence can be taken for one to five years at a time.
K-MUNI-05.steps: 1. Apply online on the GBA (BBMP) trade licence page. 2. Upload documents and pay the fee. 3. Health officials may inspect. 4. Download the licence.
K-MUNI-05.documents: Owner's consent letter or lease agreement; electricity bill
K-MUNI-05.fee_and_time: Fee depends on the trade; about 30 days
K-MUNI-05.where_to_go: Online; Medical Officer of Health (MOH) office of your zone
K-MUNI-05.check_note: BBMP/GBA trade licence pages and FAQ: online new/renewal, licence for 1 to 5 years, docs owner consent/lease + electricity bill; MOH office. 30 days per Udyog Mitra.

K-MUNI-06.title: Report garbage not collected
K-MUNI-06.answer: In Bengaluru, report missed garbage collection on Sahaaya 2.0 or by calling 1533, with the street and ward.
K-MUNI-06.steps: 1. Report with location. 2. Note complaint number.
K-MUNI-06.where_to_go: City helpline or app; ward office
K-MUNI-06.check_note: GBA: Sahaaya 2.0 grievance system and toll-free 1533 confirmed; complaint category not checked

K-MUNI-07.title: Report a pothole or broken streetlight
K-MUNI-07.answer: In Bengaluru, report potholes and broken streetlights on Sahaaya 2.0 or by calling 1533, with the exact location and a landmark.
K-MUNI-07.steps: 1. Report with location. 2. Note complaint number.
K-MUNI-07.where_to_go: City helpline or app; ward office

K-MUNI-08.title: Building plan approval
K-MUNI-08.answer: In Bengaluru, you need building plan approval from the Greater Bengaluru Authority before you start building. You apply online through a registered architect, and approvals are issued online.
K-MUNI-08.steps: 1. Your registered architect applies online with drawings and documents. 2. Site inspection. 3. Pay fees online. 4. Download the digitally signed approval.
K-MUNI-08.where_to_go: GBA online building plan approval system (BPAS); GBA town planning office
K-MUNI-08.check_note: GBA BPAS portal (Nambike Nakshe) and FAQ: online application through a registered architect with documents, site inspection, online payment, digitally signed approvals.

K-MUNI-09.title: Birth and death certificates (urban)
K-MUNI-09.answer: In Bengaluru, births and deaths should be registered within 21 days. Hospitals usually report them, and the city's health officers register them on e-Janma. You can download the certificate from Seva Sindhu for a small fee.
K-MUNI-09.fee_and_time: Register within 21 days; small fee for download on Seva Sindhu
K-MUNI-09.where_to_go: Hospital; GBA ward health office; Seva Sindhu portal
K-MUNI-09.check_note: e-Janma site: Bengaluru births/deaths registered by GBA health officers; certificates downloadable via Seva Sindhu for a fee. CRS: report within 21 days.

K-MUNI-10.title: Water tanker request
K-MUNI-10.answer: If your water supply stops in Bengaluru, call BWSSB on 1916, any time. They can tell you about repairs and whether a tanker can be arranged in your area.
K-MUNI-10.check_note: BWSSB official site confirms 24x7 helpline 1916. No official page found on tanker booking or charges.

K-MUNI-11.title: Stray dog or dead animal complaint
K-MUNI-11.answer: In Bengaluru, report stray dog or dead animal issues on Sahaaya 2.0 or by calling 1533.

K-MUNI-12.title: Tree fall or tree cutting permission
K-MUNI-12.answer: In Bengaluru, report fallen trees on Sahaaya 2.0 or 1533. Cutting a tree needs permission from the tree officer.

K-MUNI-13.title: Drain blockage and flooding complaint
K-MUNI-13.answer: In Bengaluru, report blocked drains and waterlogging on Sahaaya 2.0 or by calling 1533.

K-MUNI-14.title: Urban housing (PMAY-Urban 2.0)
K-MUNI-14.who_its_for: Urban families without a pucca house, in income groups set by the scheme
K-MUNI-14.answer: Urban families in the EWS, LIG and MIG groups who don't own a pucca house anywhere in India can get help to build, buy or rent a home under PMAY-Urban 2.0. EWS means family income up to ₹3 lakh a year.
K-MUNI-14.steps: 1. Check eligibility and apply on the PMAY-U portal. 2. Verification by the city.
K-MUNI-14.check_note: PIB: PMAY-U 2.0 for EWS/LIG/MIG families with no pucca house anywhere in India; EWS = income up to ₹3 lakh

K-MUNI-15.title: Street vendor loans (PM SVANidhi)
K-MUNI-15.answer: Street vendors can get collateral-free working-capital loans in three steps: ₹15,000, then ₹25,000, then ₹50,000, with interest subsidy. After repaying the second loan they can get a UPI-linked RuPay credit card with a limit up to ₹30,000. The scheme runs until March 2030.
K-MUNI-15.steps: 1. Apply at a bank or CSC or online. 2. City verifies vendor status.
K-MUNI-15.documents: Vending certificate or letter of recommendation; Aadhaar
K-MUNI-15.check_note: PIB: restructured Aug 2025 – collateral-free loans ₹15,000 / ₹25,000 / ₹50,000; UPI RuPay credit card up to ₹30,000 after 2nd tranche; extended to March 2030

K-MUNI-16.title: Advertisement and hoarding permission
K-MUNI-16.answer: In Bengaluru, hoardings, banners and other outdoor ads need permission from the Greater Bengaluru Authority under its advertisement bye-laws. Plastic banners are not allowed.
K-MUNI-16.check_note: BBMP Advertisement Bye-laws on BBMP/GBA site confirm permission needed for hoardings, banners. Current fees and process not confirmed.

K-MUNI-17.title: Public toilet and sanitation complaint
K-MUNI-17.answer: You can report a dirty or broken public toilet on the Swachhata app. In Bengaluru, you can also call 1533 or use the Sahaaya 2.0 app.
K-MUNI-17.check_note: PIB/MoHUA confirm Swachhata app for cleanliness complaints; GBA site confirms helpline 1533 and Sahaaya 2.0 for Bengaluru grievances.

K-MUNI-18.title: Road cutting permission
K-MUNI-18.answer: In Bengaluru, you need permission from the Greater Bengaluru Authority to dig a road for water, sewer or power lines. You apply online, an engineer checks the site, and you pay the charges shown in the demand note.
K-MUNI-18.where_to_go: GBA online road cutting permission system; ward engineering office
K-MUNI-18.check_note: BBMP/GBA MARCS page: online road cutting permission for water, electrical, sanitary lines; AEE inspects, then demand note for charges.

K-MUNI-19.title: Mosquito control and fogging
K-MUNI-19.answer: If there are many mosquitoes or dengue cases near you, call the Greater Bengaluru Authority on 1533 or raise it on Sahaaya 2.0. The ward health team handles larva control and fogging.
K-MUNI-19.where_to_go: GBA helpline 1533; Sahaaya 2.0; ward health office
K-MUNI-19.check_note: BBMP health RTI disclosure confirms health staff do larva source reduction and adult mosquito control. GBA 1533 and Sahaaya 2.0 confirmed. No fogging request page found.

K-MUNI-20.title: Burial and cremation ground booking
K-MUNI-20.answer: The Greater Bengaluru Authority runs electric crematoria and burial grounds. You can book a crematorium slot online on the GBA website, or call 1533 for help.
K-MUNI-20.where_to_go: GBA website (Electric Crematorium online booking); helpline 1533
K-MUNI-20.check_note: BBMP/GBA citizen services page lists electric crematorium online booking, contact details and burial ground list. Fees not confirmed.

K-POLI-01.title: Emergency help (112)
K-POLI-01.answer: Call 112 for police, fire or ambulance in any emergency. It works across India, 24 hours a day.

K-POLI-02.title: Lost money to cyber fraud: what to do
K-POLI-02.who_its_for: Anyone who lost money online or by phone
K-POLI-02.answer: Call 1930 straight away or report on cybercrime.gov.in. The sooner it is reported, the better the chance of stopping the money. Also inform your bank.
K-POLI-02.steps: 1. Call 1930 at once. 2. Report on cybercrime.gov.in. 3. Inform your bank.

K-POLI-03.title: Block a lost or stolen phone (CEIR)
K-POLI-03.answer: File a police report, get a duplicate SIM, then block the phone on Sanchar Saathi. It will stop working on all networks, and can be traced and unblocked when found.
K-POLI-03.steps: 1. File a police report. 2. Get a duplicate SIM. 3. Submit the block request on Sanchar Saathi with the report.
K-POLI-03.documents: Police report copy; duplicate SIM; IMEI if known
K-POLI-03.check_note: CEIR FAQ: police report + duplicate SIM

K-POLI-04.title: Report suspicious calls and messages (Chakshu)
K-POLI-04.answer: Report fraud calls, SMS or WhatsApp messages on Chakshu in Sanchar Saathi, even if no money was lost.

K-POLI-05.title: Check mobile numbers in your name
K-POLI-05.answer: See all mobile connections issued in your name on Sanchar Saathi and report any that aren't yours.

K-POLI-06.title: Never share OTPs
K-POLI-06.answer: Banks, police and government offices will not ask for your OTP, PIN or password on a call. Hang up, and if you have lost money, call 1930 or report it at cybercrime.gov.in.
K-POLI-06.check_note: cybercrime.gov.in brochure: banks never ask for OTP, PIN or passwords; 1930 is the cyber fraud helpline. Police/govt wording not stated explicitly.

K-POLI-07.title: Report a lost document
K-POLI-07.answer: In Karnataka you can report a lost document or mobile online through the KSP e-Lost Report and get an acknowledgement straight away. It is free, and you can use the acknowledgement to apply for a duplicate.
K-POLI-07.steps: 1. File a report on KSP e-Lost Report (Karnataka State Police website or app) or Seva Sindhu. 2. Download the acknowledgement.
K-POLI-07.where_to_go: KSP e-Lost Report (ksp.karnataka.gov.in or Karnataka State Police app); Seva Sindhu
K-POLI-07.check_note: KSP site links KSP e-Lost Report; Seva Sindhu lost item complaint (mobile/document): ID proof, no fee; acknowledgement given immediately (district police).

K-POLI-08.title: File an e-FIR for theft
K-POLI-08.who_its_for: Victims of theft where the accused is unknown
K-POLI-08.answer: In Karnataka, an e-FIR can be filed online only for vehicle theft, through the e-FIR link on the Karnataka State Police or Bengaluru City Police website. For a lost phone or document use the e-Lost report and block the phone on the CEIR portal; for other crimes, go to the police station or call 112.
K-POLI-08.where_to_go: e-FIR link on ksp.karnataka.gov.in or bcp.karnataka.gov.in; police station; 112
K-POLI-08.check_note: Bengaluru City Police and KSP sites: online e-FIR is for vehicle theft only; lost mobiles via e-Lost report and CEIR portal.

K-POLI-09.title: Passport police verification
K-POLI-09.answer: For most passports, the police verify your details at the address in your application, either before or after the passport is issued. Keep your address and ID proof ready, and track the status on the Passport Seva portal.
K-POLI-09.steps: 1. Wait for police contact. 2. Show documents. 3. Track status online.
K-POLI-09.check_note: Passport Seva: police verification is done at the address in the application, before or after issue depending on mode. No-fee point not stated explicitly.

K-POLI-10.title: Tenant and domestic worker verification
K-POLI-10.answer: In Karnataka, employers can get a domestic worker's background checked by the police through Seva Sindhu, for a fee. For tenant verification, ask your local police station.
K-POLI-10.steps: 1. Apply on Seva Sindhu or at a Grama One, Bangalore One or Karnataka One centre. 2. Police check and issue the certificate.
K-POLI-10.documents: Worker's passport-size photo, ID proof and address proof
K-POLI-10.fee_and_time: Rs 375 for a background check, or Rs 750 with address check, plus Rs 35 at a service centre; up to 21 days
K-POLI-10.where_to_go: Seva Sindhu (sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in); local police station for tenants
K-POLI-10.check_note: Seva Sindhu: domestic worker police check costs Rs 375 or Rs 750, plus Rs 35 at centres, 21 days - not free. No Karnataka online tenant verification found.

K-POLI-11.title: How do I pay a traffic challan?
K-POLI-11.answer: In Bengaluru you can check and pay traffic fines online on the Karnataka One portal with your vehicle number, or at a Karnataka One centre. Challans in the national e-Challan system can also be paid on the e-Challan website.
K-POLI-11.steps: 1. Open Karnataka One or the e-Challan site. 2. Enter the vehicle number. 3. Pay online.
K-POLI-11.where_to_go: Karnataka One portal or centre; e-Challan website; traffic police
K-POLI-11.check_note: Karnataka One portal: pay traffic violation fines online (Bengaluru default) or at Karnataka One centres; national e-Challan portal also takes payment.

K-POLI-12.title: Police clearance certificate
K-POLI-12.who_its_for: People needing it for jobs abroad
K-POLI-12.answer: Passport holders who need a police clearance certificate for a job, residence or long-term visa abroad apply on the Passport Seva portal and visit a Passport Seva Kendra. It is not issued for tourist visas; Karnataka Police also issue one for study visas through Seva Sindhu.
K-POLI-12.fee_and_time: Rs 750 on Passport Seva; Rs 1,000 plus Rs 30 service charge on Seva Sindhu (study visa)
K-POLI-12.where_to_go: Passport Seva portal; Seva Sindhu (study visa)
K-POLI-12.check_note: Passport Seva: PCC fee Rs 750, for job/residence/long-term visa, not tourist visa (MEA). Seva Sindhu KSP PCC for study visa: Rs 1,000 + Rs 30, 10 days.

K-POLI-13.title: Women's helpline
K-POLI-13.answer: Call 181 for help with harassment or domestic violence. In danger, call 112.

K-POLI-14.title: Child helpline
K-POLI-14.who_its_for: Children in danger, or anyone reporting one
K-POLI-14.answer: Call 1098 for any child who needs care or protection.

K-POLI-15.title: Senior citizen helpline
K-POLI-15.answer: Call 14567 (Elder Line) for help with abuse, neglect or pension issues.

K-POLI-16.title: Complain about police inaction
K-POLI-16.answer: If a police station does not act on your complaint, write to senior officers or the district SP. For complaints about police conduct, you can also go to the District Police Complaints Authority, or the State Police Complaints Authority for officers of SP rank and above.
K-POLI-16.where_to_go: Senior officers or SP office; District Police Complaints Authority (Bengaluru Urban: 080-22268374); State Police Complaints Authority
K-POLI-16.check_note: Karnataka has District Police Complaints Authorities (Bengaluru Urban: 080-22268374) and a State authority for SP rank and above (kspca.karnataka.gov.in).

K-POLI-17.title: Permission for events and loudspeakers
K-POLI-17.answer: Public events, processions and loudspeakers need police permission in Karnataka. You can apply through Seva Sindhu or at the local police station.
K-POLI-17.documents: Name and address; date, time, place and purpose; NOC from local authorities; stage fitness certificate if any
K-POLI-17.fee_and_time: Procession or assembly: Rs 20, up to 15 working days. Loudspeaker licence: fee as shown on Seva Sindhu
K-POLI-17.check_note: KSP: procession/assembly permission Rs 20, 15 working days, from SHO. Loudspeaker licence fee differs (KSP page Rs 50 + Rs 100/day; Seva Sindhu Rs 5,000).

K-POLI-18.title: Check if a phone is genuine before buying
K-POLI-18.answer: Check the IMEI on Sanchar Saathi to see if a phone is blacklisted or stolen.

K-POLI-19.title: Fake bill and KYC scam alert
K-POLI-19.answer: Scammers send fake electricity bill, KYC or parcel messages with links. Don't click links or call numbers from such messages; check with the official office.
K-POLI-19.check_note: General advice consistent with Sanchar Saathi

K-POLI-20.title: Traffic accident: what to do
K-POLI-20.who_its_for: People involved in or witnessing an accident
K-POLI-20.answer: Call 112 or 108, help the injured if it is safe, and note the vehicle number. People who help are protected by law, and those who get a victim to hospital quickly can get a Rs 25,000 Rah-Veer reward.
K-POLI-20.check_note: PIB: Good Samaritan Rules under Sec 134A MV Act protect helpers; Rah-Veer reward now Rs 25,000. 112 is the national emergency number (cybercrime.gov.in).

K-TRAN-01.title: Learner's licence
K-TRAN-01.who_its_for: Age 16+ for gearless two-wheelers; 18+ for cars and geared two-wheelers; 20+ for transport vehicles
K-TRAN-01.answer: Apply online on Sarathi, take a short test on traffic rules, and get a learner's licence valid for 6 months anywhere in India. An expired learner's licence can't be renewed; apply for a new one.
K-TRAN-01.steps: 1. Apply on Sarathi. 2. Pay fee and book a test. 3. Take the test online or at the RTO.
K-TRAN-01.documents: Age and address proof; photo; Form 1 (self-declaration)

K-TRAN-02.title: Driving licence
K-TRAN-02.answer: After holding a learner's licence for at least 30 days, book a driving test at the RTO with the right type of vehicle. The licence is sent by speed post.
K-TRAN-02.steps: 1. Book a test slot on Sarathi. 2. Take the driving test. 3. Licence is posted.

K-TRAN-03.title: How long is a driving licence valid?
K-TRAN-03.answer: A private driving licence is valid for 20 years from issue (or until age 40, whichever is earlier), then must be renewed periodically.
K-TRAN-03.check_note: 20 years confirmed on Parivahan FAQ; age-40 rule not checked

K-TRAN-04.title: Renew a driving licence
K-TRAN-04.answer: You can apply to renew your driving licence online on the Sarathi portal. If you are 40 or older, or hold a transport licence, you also need a Form 1A medical certificate from a doctor.
K-TRAN-04.steps: 1. Open sarathi.parivahan.gov.in and select Karnataka. 2. Choose Services on Driving Licence and pick Renewal. 3. Upload documents and pay the fee. 4. Visit the RTO if an appointment is given.
K-TRAN-04.documents: Current licence; Form 1 self-declaration; Form 1A medical certificate if 40+ or transport licence; photo
K-TRAN-04.check_note: Parivahan FAQ/renewal page: renew via Sarathi 'Services on DL'; Form 1A medical needed at 40+ (and transport licences). Expired >1 yr may need a test.

K-TRAN-05.title: Duplicate driving licence
K-TRAN-05.answer: If your licence is lost, stolen or damaged, apply for a duplicate on the Sarathi portal. For a lost licence, keep a copy of the police complaint, and a copy of the old licence if you have one.
K-TRAN-05.steps: 1. Open sarathi.parivahan.gov.in and select Karnataka. 2. Choose Services on Driving Licence and pick Duplicate. 3. Upload documents, pay the fee, and visit the RTO if asked.
K-TRAN-05.documents: Form 2; copy of police complaint (if lost); copy of old licence if available
K-TRAN-05.check_note: Parivahan 'Duplicate Licence' page and Form 2: duplicate for lost/damaged DL via Sarathi; police complaint copy if lost.

K-TRAN-06.title: Vehicle registration and ownership transfer
K-TRAN-06.answer: New vehicles are usually registered through the dealer. After a sale, the ownership transfer is applied for online on the Vahan portal, using Forms 29 and 30 signed by the seller and buyer.
K-TRAN-06.steps: 1. Apply on Vahan. 2. Upload documents. 3. Pay fee. 4. Get new RC.
K-TRAN-06.documents: Forms 29 and 30; original RC; valid insurance; PUC certificate; buyer's address proof
K-TRAN-06.check_note: Parivahan FAQ/Vahan instructions confirm online transfer of ownership with Forms 29, 30, RC, insurance, PUC. Dealer registration of new vehicles not checked.

K-TRAN-07.title: Keep your licence and RC on DigiLocker or mParivahan
K-TRAN-07.answer: A digital licence and RC kept in the DigiLocker or mParivahan app are accepted by traffic police as valid. A photo or scanned copy on your phone does not count.
K-TRAN-07.check_note: PIB (MoRTH SOP) and CMVR Rule 139: DL/RC in DigiLocker or mParivahan are valid like originals; scans/photos are not.

K-TRAN-08.title: Shakti free bus travel for women (Karnataka)
K-TRAN-08.who_its_for: Women and transgender persons resident in Karnataka
K-TRAN-08.answer: Women can travel free in ordinary and express buses run by Karnataka's state transport corporations within the state by showing an ID.
K-TRAN-08.documents: Government ID with Karnataka address (or Shakti smart card)
K-TRAN-08.check_note: Guarantee scheme listed on Seva Sindhu; bus categories not checked

K-TRAN-09.title: Student bus pass (Karnataka)
K-TRAN-09.answer: In Karnataka, students apply for free or concession KSRTC and BMTC bus passes online on Seva Sindhu. Once the school or college approves it, you get an SMS saying which counter to collect the pass from.
K-TRAN-09.steps: 1. Apply on Seva Sindhu. 2. School or college approves. 3. Collect the pass from the counter named in the SMS.
K-TRAN-09.documents: Declaration signed by headmaster or principal; passport photo; current year fee receipt; SC/ST certificate if applicable
K-TRAN-09.fee_and_time: No application fee online; Rs 35 service charge at Grama One / Bangalore One / Karnataka One; about 15 days
K-TRAN-09.where_to_go: Seva Sindhu portal; Grama One / Bangalore One / Karnataka One centres
K-TRAN-09.check_note: KSRTC student pass page and Seva Sindhu: apply online on Seva Sindhu only; free online, Rs 35 at Grama One/B1/K1; 15 days. BMTC also via Seva Sindhu/B1.

K-TRAN-10.title: Pay traffic fines (e-Challan)
K-TRAN-10.answer: You can check and pay traffic challans online on the e-Challan portal using your challan number, vehicle number or driving licence number.
K-TRAN-10.documents: Challan number, vehicle number or DL number
K-TRAN-10.check_note: echallan.parivahan.gov.in: check and pay by challan number, vehicle number or DL number.

K-TRAN-11.title: FASTag
K-TRAN-11.answer: FASTag is needed to pay tolls on national highways. Without a valid FASTag you pay double the toll in cash, or 1.25 times if you pay by UPI. Private cars can also buy a FASTag Annual Pass on the Rajmargyatra app or NHAI website.
K-TRAN-11.fee_and_time: Tag fee plus balance; Annual Pass Rs 3,075 for 2026–27, valid one year or 200 toll crossings
K-TRAN-11.where_to_go: Banks; payment apps; Rajmargyatra app for Annual Pass
K-TRAN-11.check_note: PIB: no valid FASTag = 2x toll in cash, 1.25x by UPI; FASTag Annual Pass Rs 3,075 for FY 2026-27 (1 yr/200 crossings) via Rajmargyatra/NHAI.

K-TRAN-12.title: Highway emergency help
K-TRAN-12.answer: Call 1033, the free 24-hour National Highway helpline, for accidents, breakdowns or other help on national highways.
K-TRAN-12.check_note: NHAI highway operations FAQ and PIB: 1033 is the 24x7 toll-free National Highway helpline for emergencies and complaints.

K-TRAN-13.title: Rail help
K-TRAN-13.answer: Call 139 for train enquiries, safety and complaints, or use RailMadad.
K-TRAN-13.check_note: PIB: 139 is the integrated RailMadad helpline (enquiry, complaints, security; 182 merged), 24x7 in 12 languages; also web, app, SMS.

K-TRAN-14.title: Pollution certificate (PUC)
K-TRAN-14.answer: A valid PUC certificate is needed to drive. Get it at an authorised PUC centre; it is saved in the national Vahan database, and you can download a copy online with your vehicle number.
K-TRAN-14.check_note: PIB/MoRTH: PUC data linked to Vahan; Vahan PUC portal issues and lets you download certificates by registration number.

K-TRAN-15.title: Hypothecation removal after loan repayment
K-TRAN-15.who_its_for: Vehicle owners who repaid a loan
K-TRAN-15.answer: After repaying a vehicle loan, apply online to remove the bank's name from the RC.
K-TRAN-15.documents: Form 35 signed by owner and bank; bank NOC or dues clearance letter; RC; insurance
K-TRAN-15.check_note: Parivahan FAQ and mParivahan: hypothecation termination online on Vahan; Form 35 signed by owner and financier plus dues clearance.

K-TRAN-16.title: Address change on RC or licence
K-TRAN-16.answer: Apply online on Vahan to change the address on your RC, and on Sarathi for your driving licence. For the RC, this should be done within 14 days of moving.
K-TRAN-16.documents: Proof of new address; RC or licence; insurance and PUC (for RC); bank NOC if the vehicle is on loan
K-TRAN-16.check_note: Parivahan FAQ: address change online on Vahan (RC) and Sarathi (DL); mParivahan: RC change within 14 days, Form 33.

K-TRAN-17.title: Report a bus complaint
K-TRAN-17.answer: For KSRTC buses, call the 24-hour helpline 080-26252625. For BMTC city buses in Bengaluru, call 080-22483777. Please share the bus number, route, date and time.
K-TRAN-17.check_note: KSRTC contact page: 24x7 call centre 080-26252625, ctmopn@ksrtc.org; BMTC site: helpline 080-22483777.

K-TRAN-18.title: International driving permit
K-TRAN-18.answer: Apply on Sarathi or at your RTO for an International Driving Permit. It is valid for up to one year, or until your Indian licence expires, whichever is earlier.
K-TRAN-18.documents: Valid Indian licence; passport; visa where applicable; air ticket; Form 4A; photos
K-TRAN-18.check_note: Parivahan IDP page and Form 6A: Form 4A to RTO; valid max 1 year or until DL expiry, whichever earlier; passport, visa, air ticket.

K-TRAN-19.title: Road safety basics
K-TRAN-19.answer: Wear a helmet and seatbelt, don't drink and drive, and don't use the phone while driving.
K-TRAN-19.check_note: PIB (MV Amendment Act 2019): stricter penalties for drunk driving (Rs 10,000), dangerous driving, helmets; MoRTH lists phone use as key cause.

K-TRAN-20.title: Cashless treatment for road accident victims
K-TRAN-20.answer: Under the PM-RAHAT scheme, any road accident victim can get free cashless treatment up to Rs 1.5 lakh, for up to 7 days from the accident, at designated hospitals.
K-TRAN-20.fee_and_time: Free up to Rs 1.5 lakh per victim, within 7 days of the accident
K-TRAN-20.check_note: PIB: scheme notified 5 May 2025, renamed PM-RAHAT (Feb 2026); cashless up to Rs 1.5 lakh/victim for 7 days at designated hospitals, any road.

K-LAND-01.title: View land record (RTC/Pahani)
K-LAND-01.answer: The land record (RTC) shows the owner, extent and crops, and can be viewed online with the survey number.
K-LAND-01.steps: 1. Open landrecords.karnataka.gov.in and choose View RTC and MR. 2. Select district, taluk, hobli and village. 3. Enter the survey number, surnoc and hissa.
K-LAND-01.fee_and_time: Free to view; digitally signed RTC Rs 15 online
K-LAND-01.check_note: Bhoomi site: anyone can view any RTC by district/taluk/hobli/village/survey no.; digitally signed i-RTC Rs 15 online.

K-LAND-02.title: Mutation (change of name in land record)
K-LAND-02.who_its_for: New owners after sale, inheritance or partition
K-LAND-02.answer: After a sale, inheritance or partition, the land record is updated through mutation. A notice is issued for objections before the change is made, and you can check mutation status online on the Bhoomi site.
K-LAND-02.steps: 1. Registration triggers mutation, or apply at the taluk office. 2. Objection period. 3. Record updated.
K-LAND-02.documents: Sale deed or death certificate and family tree
K-LAND-02.check_note: Bhoomi: ownership changes in RTC done by mutation under KLR Act; status viewable online/SMS. Exact objection period not confirmed.

K-LAND-03.title: Income certificate
K-LAND-03.who_its_for: Residents needing it for benefits, scholarships, jobs
K-LAND-03.answer: An income certificate is issued by the revenue department after verification.
K-LAND-03.steps: 1. Apply online or at Nada Kacheri. 2. Village accountant verifies. 3. Download or collect.
K-LAND-03.documents: ID proof; address proof; ration card; voter ID; salary certificate or self-declaration; bank statement (urban)
K-LAND-03.where_to_go: Seva Sindhu; Nadakacheri; Grama One / Bangalore One
K-LAND-03.check_note: Seva Sindhu income certificate page: Rs 25 fee, 21 days; documents listed. Issued via Nadakacheri (AJSK).

K-LAND-04.title: Caste certificate
K-LAND-04.answer: A caste certificate is issued by the revenue department after verification.
K-LAND-04.steps: 1. Apply online or at Nada Kacheri. 2. Verification. 3. Download or collect.
K-LAND-04.documents: ID and address proof; ration card; voter ID; old caste certificate, or relatives' certificate and family tree; school certificate
K-LAND-04.where_to_go: Seva Sindhu; Nadakacheri; Grama One / Bangalore One
K-LAND-04.check_note: Seva Sindhu caste certificate page: Rs 25 fee, 21 days; documents listed.

K-LAND-05.title: Residence certificate
K-LAND-05.answer: A residence certificate proves you live permanently in a village, town or ward, and is used for government benefits, admissions and jobs. You can apply on Seva Sindhu or at a Nadakacheri.
K-LAND-05.documents: ID proof; address proof; ration card; voter ID; rental agreement if renting (urban)
K-LAND-05.check_note: Seva Sindhu residence certificate: proof of permanent residence for govt benefits; Rs 25; 7 days (Nadakacheri list says 14).

K-LAND-06.title: My land record has a wrong name or extent
K-LAND-06.answer: Mistakes in your land record can be corrected by applying at the Tahsildar's office with supporting documents. The Assistant Commissioner decides after an enquiry, usually within 40 working days.
K-LAND-06.steps: 1. Apply at the Tahsildar's office. 2. Enquiry. 3. Assistant Commissioner's order and correction.
K-LAND-06.fee_and_time: Fee as fixed by government; up to 40 working days
K-LAND-06.check_note: AC Ballari official service page: RTC error correction applied at Tahsildar office, decided by Assistant Commissioner, 40 working days.

K-LAND-07.title: Property registration (Kaveri)
K-LAND-07.answer: Sale deeds and other property documents are registered at the sub-registrar office. On Kaveri 2.0 you can enter the details, pay stamp duty and fees online, and book a slot before you visit.
K-LAND-07.steps: 1. Prepare and pay online. 2. Book slot. 3. Visit sub-registrar with parties and witnesses.
K-LAND-07.check_note: IGR Karnataka: Kaveri 2.0 for pre-registration data entry, online duty payment and slot booking at SRO. Witness rules not checked.

K-LAND-08.title: Encumbrance certificate (EC)
K-LAND-08.answer: An encumbrance certificate shows the registered transactions on a property. You can apply for it online on the Kaveri 2.0 portal.
K-LAND-08.check_note: IGR Karnataka EC FAQ: EC shows registered transactions; apply online on Kaveri 2.0 (post-2004 online; earlier periods also via Kaveri 2.0 to SR).

K-LAND-09.title: Check land survey maps
K-LAND-09.answer: You can view survey documents like the tippan, atlas and village maps online on the Karnataka land records site, and apply online for copies. The Dishaank app shows survey numbers on a map.
K-LAND-09.where_to_go: landrecords.karnataka.gov.in (Survey documents, Revenue Maps); Dishaank app; taluk survey office
K-LAND-09.check_note: Karnataka revenue portal: view tippan/atlas/pakka book online, apply online for survey documents, revenue maps download, Dishaank app.

K-LAND-10.title: Legal heir / family tree certificate
K-LAND-10.answer: After a death, families can get the family tree attested, or get a surviving family member certificate, from the revenue department. These are often needed for mutation and claims, and you can apply on Seva Sindhu or at a Nadakacheri.
K-LAND-10.documents: Death certificate; affidavit; ID and address proof; ration card
K-LAND-10.check_note: Seva Sindhu: 'Attestation of Family Tree' and 'Surviving Family Member Certificate', Rs 25 each, 7 days; used for inheritance.

K-LAND-11.title: Unique Land Parcel ID (Bhu-Aadhaar)
K-LAND-11.answer: Each land parcel is being given a 14-character Bhu-Aadhaar, or ULPIN, a unique ID based on its map location, to link land records.
K-LAND-11.check_note: PIB DoLR Year-End Review 2025: ULPIN/Bhu-Aadhaar is a 14-digit alphanumeric geo-coordinate ID; 36 crore parcels in 29 States/UTs.

K-LAND-12.title: Property card for village homes (SVAMITVA)
K-LAND-12.who_its_for: Owners of houses in village areas
K-LAND-12.answer: Drone surveys create property cards for houses in village residential areas, which can be used for loans.
K-LAND-12.check_note: PIB: SVAMITVA uses drone surveys of village abadi areas to issue property cards, enabling bank loans; Karnataka is covered.

K-LAND-13.title: Agricultural land conversion
K-LAND-13.answer: Using farm land for non-farm purposes needs conversion approval from the Deputy Commissioner. In Karnataka you apply online on the land records portal, and land within a master plan area can use a simpler deemed conversion route.
K-LAND-13.check_note: Karnataka land conversion portal: online application, DC approval; master-plan deemed conversion and affidavit-based routes exist.

K-LAND-14.title: Small/marginal farmer certificate
K-LAND-14.answer: A certificate showing small or marginal farmer status, used for subsidies.
K-LAND-14.documents: RTCs of all family land; ration card or voter ID
K-LAND-14.check_note: Seva Sindhu Small and Marginal Farmer Certificate: for farmer subsidies/loans; RTCs + ration/voter card; Rs 25; 7 days.

K-LAND-15.title: Non-creamy layer certificate (OBC)
K-LAND-15.who_its_for: OBC applicants for jobs and admissions
K-LAND-15.answer: For OBC reservation in central jobs and admissions, you need the OBC (Central) certificate showing non-creamy layer status. Apply on Seva Sindhu or at a Nadakacheri.
K-LAND-15.documents: ID and address proof; ration card; voter ID; old caste certificate; school certificate
K-LAND-15.check_note: Seva Sindhu lists OBC Certificate (Central) and Non-Creamy Layer certificates, Rs 25, 21 days; PIB: OBC creamy layer limit Rs 8 lakh.

K-LAND-16.title: EWS certificate
K-LAND-16.who_its_for: General category applicants within income limit
K-LAND-16.answer: An EWS income and asset certificate lets eligible applicants not covered by SC, ST or OBC quotas claim the 10% EWS quota. For central jobs, family income must be below Rs 8 lakh a year, and there are limits on land and house size.
K-LAND-16.check_note: PIB/DoPT: EWS 10% quota, family income below Rs 8 lakh plus asset limits; Nadakacheri issues Income and Asset Certificate (EWS) in 21 days.

K-LAND-17.title: Revenue court case status
K-LAND-17.answer: You can check the status of cases in Tahsildar, Assistant Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner revenue courts online on the RCCMS portal.
K-LAND-17.check_note: RCCMS portal (Revenue Dept, Bhoomi Monitoring Cell) tracks cases in DC, AC and Tahsildar courts; online case filing; citizens can view.

K-LAND-18.title: Land acquisition compensation status
K-LAND-18.answer: People whose land was acquired can check compensation status with the land acquisition officer.
K-LAND-18.check_note: Bhoomi land acquisition system links LA offices with land records; no public online compensation-status service found.

K-LAND-19.title: How long does a certificate take?
K-LAND-19.answer: Every Seva Sindhu service has a fixed time limit under Sakala, for example 21 days for an income or caste certificate. You can check status with your application number, and appeal if it is late.
K-LAND-19.check_note: Sakala site: services guaranteed within stipulated time; status by GSC number online/SMS; appeal if delayed. Seva Sindhu: income/caste 21 days.

K-LAND-20.title: Track application status
K-LAND-20.answer: Track any Seva Sindhu application online with the application number.
K-LAND-20.check_note: Seva Sindhu FAQ: track any application with the Application Reference Number on the homepage; SMS updates at each step.

K-LABO-01.title: Rural jobs guarantee (VB-G RAM G, replaced MGNREGA from 1 July 2026)
K-LABO-01.who_its_for: Adults in rural households willing to do unskilled manual work
K-LABO-01.answer: Since 1 July 2026, rural households are guaranteed 125 days of paid work a year under the new VB-G RAM G Act, which replaced MGNREGA. Work must be given within 15 days of asking, or an unemployment allowance is due.
K-LABO-01.steps: 1. Apply for work at the gram panchayat. 2. Work given within 15 days. 3. Wages paid to the bank account.
K-LABO-01.documents: Job card (MGNREGA cards with eKYC stay valid until new cards are issued); bank account
K-LABO-01.check_note: PIB: Act in force from 1 July 2026; 125 days; MGNREGA repealed
