K-LABO-02.title: My rural job wages are late
K-LABO-02.answer: Wages should be paid weekly, or within 15 days of the muster roll closing. If late, workers are entitled to delay compensation. Raise it with the gram panchayat or block programme officer.
K-LABO-02.check_note: PIB on VB-G RAM G Act wage timelines

K-LABO-03.title: Is my old MGNREGA job card still valid?
K-LABO-03.answer: Yes. MGNREGA job cards with eKYC done stay valid until the new Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Cards are issued.

K-LABO-04.title: e-Shram registration
K-LABO-04.answer: Unorganised workers can register free on e-Shram and get a lifelong UAN number that links them to welfare and social security schemes.
K-LABO-04.steps: 1. Register online or at a CSC with Aadhaar and mobile. 2. Download the e-Shram card. 3. Keep profile and occupation updated.

K-LABO-05.title: Pension for unorganised workers (PM-SYM)
K-LABO-05.who_its_for: Unorganised workers aged 18–40 earning up to ₹15,000 a month
K-LABO-05.answer: Workers who pay a small monthly amount until 60 get an assured pension of ₹3,000 a month. The government adds an equal amount.
K-LABO-05.steps: 1. Enrol at a CSC or on Maandhan. 2. Monthly contribution auto-debited.

K-LABO-06.title: Construction workers welfare board (Karnataka)
K-LABO-06.answer: Registered construction workers can get help such as education money for children, medical and accident help, maternity and marriage help, and a Rs 1,000 monthly pension after age 60. In Bengaluru, registered workers can also get a free BMTC bus pass.
K-LABO-06.steps: 1. Register with the board online or at a Seva Sindhu / Karnataka One / Grama One centre. 2. Renew every year with proof of 90 days' construction work. 3. Apply separately for each benefit.
K-LABO-06.documents: Aadhaar; employment certificate for 90 days' work in the last 12 months (from employer, registered union, labour inspector or gram panchayat); bank passbook
K-LABO-06.fee_and_time: No application fee online; registration is decided within 45 days
K-LABO-06.where_to_go: Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (online or Seva Sindhu centre); labour helpline 155214
K-LABO-06.check_note: KBOCWWB site: registration needs 90 days' work in past 12 months (Form V(A)-(D)), Rs 0 fee online, 45 days. Labour dept page lists pension Rs 1,000/month, education, medical, BMTC pass.

K-LABO-07.title: Skill training
K-LABO-07.answer: Free short-term skill courses with a certificate are offered under PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana at listed training centres. You can find courses and centres on the Skill India Digital Hub.
K-LABO-07.where_to_go: Skill India Digital; district skill office
K-LABO-07.check_note: PIB confirms PMKVY 4.0 free short-term training and certification listed on Skill India Digital Hub. 'District skill office' as a walk-in point not confirmed.

K-LABO-08.title: Yuva Nidhi unemployment allowance (Karnataka)
K-LABO-08.who_its_for: Unemployed graduates and diploma holders in Karnataka
K-LABO-08.answer: Eligible unemployed graduates and diploma holders get a monthly allowance for up to two years.
K-LABO-08.steps: 1. Register on Seva Sindhu. 2. Self-declare every month while unemployed.
K-LABO-08.documents: Degree or diploma certificate; Aadhaar; bank account

K-LABO-09.title: Find jobs (National Career Service)
K-LABO-09.answer: You can search jobs, find job fairs and get career counselling on the National Career Service portal. It is free at every stage, and the helpline is 1514.
K-LABO-09.where_to_go: NCS portal; NCS helpline 1514; employment exchange
K-LABO-09.check_note: ncs.gov.in: job search, job fairs and counselling; NCS charges no fee at any stage; toll-free helpline 1514.

K-LABO-10.title: Unpaid wages complaint (private jobs)
K-LABO-10.answer: If you were not paid, or paid less than you are owed, you can complain to the Karnataka Labour Department. Call the free 24-hour labour helpline 155214, or visit your nearest labour office.
K-LABO-10.where_to_go: Labour helpline 155214 (24x7); nearest Labour Officer / Assistant Labour Commissioner office
K-LABO-10.check_note: Labour dept 24x7 helpline 155214 confirmed on labour.karnataka.gov.in; wages now under Code on Wages (from 21 Nov 2025, PIB). Exact claim procedure not confirmed.

K-LABO-11.title: ESIC health cover for workers
K-LABO-11.who_its_for: Employees earning up to the ESI wage limit in covered establishments
K-LABO-11.answer: If you earn up to Rs 21,000 a month in a covered workplace, ESIC gives you and your family free medical care, and cash help during sickness, maternity or a work injury. Your employer deducts and pays the contribution.
K-LABO-11.check_note: ESIC standard note: covers employees earning up to Rs 21,000/month (Rs 25,000 for PwD); medical care plus sickness, maternity, disablement, dependants' benefits.

K-LABO-12.title: Check PF balance (EPFO)
K-LABO-12.answer: You can check your PF balance on the EPFO passbook portal or UMANG app using your UAN. You can also give a missed call to 9966044425 from your registered mobile.
K-LABO-12.where_to_go: EPFO passbook portal; UMANG; missed call 9966044425; SMS 'EPFOHO UAN' to 7738299899; helpline 1800118005
K-LABO-12.check_note: EPFO site: passbook portal with UAN, missed call 9966044425 or SMS EPFOHO UAN to 7738299899 from registered mobile; UMANG also offers it.

K-LABO-13.title: Accident insurance (PMSBY)
K-LABO-13.answer: PM Suraksha Bima gives Rs 2 lakh cover for accidental death or full disability, and Rs 1 lakh for partial disability. The premium is Rs 20 a year, taken automatically from your bank account.
K-LABO-13.fee_and_time: Rs 20 a year; cover runs 1 June to 31 May
K-LABO-13.check_note: PIB 2025: PMSBY for savings account holders aged 18-70, Rs 20/year premium auto-debited; Rs 2 lakh accidental death/full disability, Rs 1 lakh partial disability.

K-LABO-14.title: Life insurance (PMJJBY)
K-LABO-14.answer: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima gives Rs 2 lakh life cover for death from any cause. The premium is Rs 436 a year, taken automatically from your bank or post office account.
K-LABO-14.fee_and_time: Rs 436 a year (less if you join mid-year)
K-LABO-14.check_note: DFS/jansuraksha: PMJJBY ages 18-50 to join, Rs 2 lakh death cover any cause, Rs 436/year auto-debit, cover 1 June-31 May.

K-LABO-15.title: Atal Pension Yojana
K-LABO-15.answer: A guaranteed pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 a month from age 60, based on monthly contributions.
K-LABO-15.check_note: PFRDA: APY ages 18-40; income-tax payers barred from 1 Oct 2022; guaranteed pension Rs 1,000-5,000/month from 60.

K-LABO-16.title: Apprenticeship
K-LABO-16.answer: Paid apprenticeships are listed on the apprenticeship portal. You get a monthly stipend, and the government adds up to Rs 1,500 a month straight to your bank account.
K-LABO-16.check_note: PIB: apprentices get a stipend; under NAPS-2 govt pays 25% of it (up to Rs 1,500/month) by DBT to the apprentice's bank account.

K-LABO-17.title: Migrant worker help
K-LABO-17.answer: Migrant workers can register on e-Shram and get ration anywhere under One Nation One Ration Card.
K-LABO-17.where_to_go: e-Shram portal (helpline 14434); any ration shop; labour helpline 155214
K-LABO-17.check_note: PIB: e-Shram covers migrant and other unorganised workers (one-time registration); ONORC lets NFSA ration be taken at any fair price shop in India.

K-LABO-18.title: Job fair announcement
K-LABO-18.answer: District job fairs are announced by the employment department. The agent should read only the current notice.

K-LABO-19.title: Mudra loans for small businesses
K-LABO-19.answer: Mudra gives business loans without collateral through banks: Shishu up to Rs 50,000, Kishor up to Rs 5 lakh, Tarun up to Rs 10 lakh, and Tarun Plus up to Rs 20 lakh for those who have repaid a Tarun loan.
K-LABO-19.check_note: PIB: collateral-free Mudra loans up to Rs 20 lakh: Shishu to Rs 50k, Kishor to Rs 5 lakh, Tarun to Rs 10 lakh, Tarun Plus to Rs 20 lakh (after repaying a Tarun loan).

K-LABO-20.title: Child labour complaint
K-LABO-20.answer: Report child labour to the labour department, 1098 or the PENCIL portal.
K-LABO-20.where_to_go: Child Helpline 1098; PENCIL portal; labour helpline 155214
K-LABO-20.check_note: PIB: child labour can be reported on PENCIL portal (complaint corner, handled by district nodal officer) or Child Helpline 1098 (24x7, linked to 112).

K-WELF-01.title: Free ration under NFSA
K-WELF-01.who_its_for: Families with Antyodaya (AAY) or priority household (PHH) ration cards
K-WELF-01.answer: Food grains are free of cost. Antyodaya families get 35 kg per family per month; priority households get 5 kg per person per month. Free distribution is extended for five years from 1 January 2024.
K-WELF-01.documents: Ration card; Aadhaar for biometric check

K-WELF-02.title: What if I don't get my full ration?
K-WELF-02.answer: You are entitled to your full quantity free. If the shop gives less or asks for money, complain to the food department helpline or the taluk food inspector. If grain isn't supplied, the Act provides a food security allowance.
K-WELF-02.check_note: Food security allowance in NFSA; Karnataka helpline not checked

K-WELF-03.title: Get ration anywhere (One Nation One Ration Card)
K-WELF-03.who_its_for: Ration card holders, especially migrant workers
K-WELF-03.answer: If you have a ration card under the food security scheme, you can collect your ration from any fair price shop in India after Aadhaar fingerprint or OTP check. Your family back home can still take the rest of the ration.
K-WELF-03.check_note: PIB ONORC factsheet: NFSA ration from any fair price shop in India with existing card; family back home can take balance. Ahara: Aadhaar OTP or fingerprint.

K-WELF-04.title: New ration card or adding a member (Karnataka)
K-WELF-04.answer: Changes to an existing ration card, like adding a member, can be applied for online or at a service centre. For new priority (BPL) cards, the food department is currently only clearing applications received before March 2023, so please check the Ahara website for any new opening.
K-WELF-04.steps: 1. Apply on the Ahara portal or at a Bangalore One / Karnataka One / Grama One centre. 2. Food inspector verifies. 3. Card issued or updated.
K-WELF-04.documents: Aadhaar of all family members (mandatory); other papers only if asked
K-WELF-04.fee_and_time: No application fee; centres may charge about Rs 20
K-WELF-04.where_to_go: Ahara portal; Bangalore One / Karnataka One / Grama One centre; taluk food office
K-WELF-04.check_note: Ahara: dept is only processing new-card applications received before March 2023; Seva Sindhu offers Family ID/APL card; new card service Rs 0 fee, Rs 20 centre charge. BPL reopening not confirmed.

K-WELF-05.title: Anna Bhagya (Karnataka)
K-WELF-05.who_its_for: BPL and Antyodaya ration card holders in Karnataka
K-WELF-05.answer: Karnataka gives eligible families extra food support on top of the central free ration under Anna Bhagya. The current form (extra grain or cash) is set by the state.
K-WELF-05.check_note: Guarantee scheme confirmed; current form of benefit not checked

K-WELF-06.title: Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)
K-WELF-06.who_its_for: Woman head of household (BPL or APL) in Karnataka
K-WELF-06.answer: The woman head of an eligible family gets ₹2,000 a month in her bank account.
K-WELF-06.steps: 1. Register on the Seva Sindhu guarantee portal or at a service centre. 2. Money goes to the bank monthly.
K-WELF-06.where_to_go: Seva Sindhu guarantee portal; Grama One / Karnataka One
K-WELF-06.check_note: Karnataka CM office: ₹2,000/month to woman head, BPL and APL

K-WELF-07.title: My Gruha Lakshmi money didn't come
K-WELF-07.answer: Gruha Lakshmi pays Rs 2,000 a month to the woman head of the family. If it has not come, the usual reasons are Aadhaar not linked to the bank account for DBT, a name mismatch, or an inactive account. Please check with your bank, then contact the CDPO office or call 1902.
K-WELF-07.where_to_go: Bank; CDPO office; service centre; state helpline 1902
K-WELF-07.check_note: CM office confirms Rs 2,000/month to woman head of family. Listed reasons for non-payment not on an official page; state grievance line 1902 confirmed on karnataka.gov.in.

K-WELF-08.title: Old-age pension
K-WELF-08.answer: In Karnataka, poor seniors can get a monthly pension: about Rs 600 at age 60 to 64, and Rs 1,200 from age 65. It is paid into your bank account.
K-WELF-08.steps: 1. Apply at Nada Kacheri or online. 2. Verification. 3. Pension paid to bank account.
K-WELF-08.documents: Age proof; Aadhaar; bank account; income certificate
K-WELF-08.fee_and_time: No fee; centres charge a small service fee (about Rs 25-30)
K-WELF-08.check_note: DSSP: Sandhya Suraksha 65+ Rs 1,200/month, income limit Rs 32,000; Khajane: IGNOAP Rs 600 (60-64), Rs 1,200 (65+). Apply via Atal Ji Janasnehi Kendra (Nada Kacheri).

K-WELF-09.title: Widow pension
K-WELF-09.answer: In Karnataka, widows from poor families with yearly income under Rs 32,000 can get a pension of Rs 800 a month.
K-WELF-09.documents: Husband's death certificate; Aadhaar; bank account
K-WELF-09.check_note: DSSP: Destitute Widow Pension for BPL widows aged 18-64, annual income under Rs 32,000, Rs 800/month, paid until remarriage; apply at Atal Ji Janasnehi Kendra.

K-WELF-10.title: Disability pension
K-WELF-10.who_its_for: Persons with disabilities above the notified level
K-WELF-10.answer: In Karnataka, people with 40% or more disability can get a monthly pension, starting at Rs 800 and higher for severe disability.
K-WELF-10.check_note: Khajane/DSSP list a Physically Handicapped Pension (Rs 800/month for 40-75% disability; higher above 75%). Exact higher amount not confirmed.

K-WELF-11.title: My pension hasn't come this month
K-WELF-11.answer: Delays usually happen when Aadhaar is not linked to your bank account or the account is inactive. Your Nada Kacheri or taluk office can check the status, or you can call the state helpline 1902.
K-WELF-11.where_to_go: Nada Kacheri (Atal Ji Janasnehi Kendra); taluk office; state helpline 1902
K-WELF-11.check_note: Karnataka DBT page confirms Aadhaar seeding is required for DBT payments. Life-certificate reason not confirmed on an official Karnataka page.

K-WELF-12.title: Free LPG connection (PM Ujjwala)
K-WELF-12.who_its_for: Adult women from poor households without an LPG connection
K-WELF-12.answer: Eligible women get a free LPG connection, with the first refill and a stove free. They also get a Rs 300 subsidy on up to 9 refills a year, paid into the bank account.
K-WELF-12.steps: 1. Apply at an LPG distributor or online. 2. eKYC. 3. Connection given.
K-WELF-12.check_note: PMUY FAQ: deposit-free connection with free first refill and stove. PIB: Rs 300 subsidy per 14.2 kg cylinder, up to 9 refills a year, paid to bank account.

K-WELF-13.title: Rural housing (PMAY-Gramin)
K-WELF-13.who_its_for: Rural households without a pucca house, from the survey list
K-WELF-13.answer: Eligible rural families on the list get Rs 1.20 lakh in instalments to build a pucca house. They can also get 90 to 95 days of wages for building the house under the new rural jobs scheme, VB-G RAM G.
K-WELF-13.steps: 1. Check the list with the gram panchayat. 2. Instalments paid as construction progresses.
K-WELF-13.documents: Aadhaar; bank account; Gramin Rozgar Guarantee Card (old MGNREGA job card stays valid until the new card is issued)
K-WELF-13.check_note: PIB: PMAY-G Rs 1.20 lakh in plains (incl. Karnataka). From 1 Jul 2026 VB-G RAM G replaced MGNREGA; PMAY-G 90/95 days' wage support continues; e-KYC'd job cards stay valid.

K-WELF-14.title: Disability certificate and UDID card
K-WELF-14.answer: Apply online for a UDID card, attend a medical assessment, and get a card valid across India.
K-WELF-14.steps: 1. Apply on the UDID portal. 2. Medical assessment. 3. Card issued.
K-WELF-14.check_note: swavlambancard.gov.in confirms online application, hospital visit, assessment by specialist doctors, card issued by state medical authority. 'Free' not confirmed.

K-WELF-15.title: Anganwadi services for children and mothers
K-WELF-15.who_its_for: Children under 6, pregnant women and new mothers
K-WELF-15.answer: Anganwadis give free hot meals or take-home rations, growth checks, pre-school for children aged 3 to 6, vaccination support, health check-ups and referrals.
K-WELF-15.check_note: PIB: Anganwadi package of six services: supplementary nutrition (hot meals/take-home ration), pre-school, nutrition-health education, immunisation, health check-up, referral.

K-WELF-16.title: Sukanya Samriddhi savings for girls
K-WELF-16.answer: Sukanya Samriddhi is a high-interest savings account for a girl under 10, with tax benefits. You can open it at a post office or bank with as little as Rs 250 a year.
K-WELF-16.documents: Girl's birth certificate; parent's ID and address proof; photo
K-WELF-16.fee_and_time: Minimum Rs 250 a year, maximum Rs 1.5 lakh a year
K-WELF-16.check_note: PIB/India Post: girls under 10; at post office or bank; min Rs 250/year, max Rs 1.5 lakh; deposits for 15 years; tax benefit under 80C.

K-WELF-17.title: Senior citizen help (Elder Line)
K-WELF-17.answer: Call 14567 for help with pensions, abuse, legal issues or care.

K-WELF-18.title: Free bank account (Jan Dhan)
K-WELF-18.answer: You can open a zero-balance Jan Dhan account at any bank. It comes with a free RuPay card with Rs 2 lakh accident cover, and an overdraft of up to Rs 10,000 later on.
K-WELF-18.check_note: PIB: PMJDY zero-balance account, free RuPay card with Rs 2 lakh accident cover (accounts after Aug 2018), overdraft up to Rs 10,000 after 6 months.

K-WELF-19.title: Check benefits you may qualify for (myScheme)
K-WELF-19.answer: myScheme lets anyone answer a few questions to see central and state schemes they may be eligible for.
K-WELF-19.check_note: myscheme.gov.in FAQ: 4,700+ central and state schemes; eligibility check from your details and yes/no questions.

K-WELF-20.title: Grama One / Karnataka One service centres
K-WELF-20.answer: Most state services, certificates, pension and ration card applications can be done at Grama One centres in villages, Karnataka One in towns, and Bangalore One centres in Bengaluru.
K-WELF-20.fee_and_time: Small service charge plus any department fee
K-WELF-20.where_to_go: Nearest Bangalore One (Bengaluru), Karnataka One or Grama One centre
K-WELF-20.check_note: Seva Sindhu: services available at Bangalore One / Karnataka One / Grama One centres; Grama One FAQ: open 8am-8pm all days, nominal service charge plus department fee.

K-ELEC-01.title: Register as a new voter (Form 6)
K-ELEC-01.answer: Fill Form 6 online on the voters' service portal or the Voter Helpline app, or on paper with the booth level officer. You can apply in advance: there are four qualifying dates a year — 1 January, 1 April, 1 July and 1 October.
K-ELEC-01.steps: 1. Fill Form 6 online or offline. 2. BLO verifies. 3. Name added; voter ID sent.
K-ELEC-01.where_to_go: Voters' service portal; Voter Helpline app; BLO
K-ELEC-01.check_note: ECI FAQ: four qualifying dates; Form 6

K-ELEC-02.title: Correct details or change address (Form 8)
K-ELEC-02.answer: Corrections, address change and replacement voter ID are applied for with Form 8.
K-ELEC-02.steps: 1. Fill Form 8 online. 2. Verification. 3. Updated card.
K-ELEC-02.documents: Voter ID (EPIC) number; proof of the correct detail
K-ELEC-02.where_to_go: Voters' service portal; Voter Helpline app

K-ELEC-03.title: Where is my polling booth?
K-ELEC-03.answer: Search your name on the electoral roll with your EPIC number to find your booth, or SMS 'ECIPS <EPIC number>' to 1950.

K-ELEC-04.title: Voter helpline 1950
K-ELEC-04.answer: Call 1950 for help with registration, voter ID, booth details and BLO contact.

K-ELEC-05.title: Which ID can I show at the booth?
K-ELEC-05.answer: Your voter ID (EPIC) is the main ID. If your name is on the voter list, you can also show one of 12 other photo IDs approved by the Election Commission, such as Aadhaar, PAN card, driving licence, passport, MGNREGA job card or a bank or post office passbook with photo.
K-ELEC-05.check_note: PIB/ECI: electors on the roll may show EPIC or any one of 12 alternative photo IDs (Aadhaar, PAN, DL, passport, MGNREGA card, photo passbook etc).

K-ELEC-06.title: Remove a name from the roll (Form 7)
K-ELEC-06.answer: Objections to an entry, or deletion of a name (for example a deceased family member), are filed with Form 7.

K-ELEC-07.title: Overseas voter registration (Form 6A)
K-ELEC-07.answer: Indian citizens living abroad who haven't taken another citizenship can register with Form 6A.

K-ELEC-08.title: Download e-EPIC (digital voter ID)
K-ELEC-08.answer: You can download your digital voter ID (e-EPIC) free from the Voters' Service Portal or the ECINET app, using your EPIC number and the mobile number registered with it.
K-ELEC-08.check_note: ECI VSP page confirms e-EPIC download; PIB 2026 confirms e-EPIC download also on the ECINET app.

K-ELEC-09.title: Find your BLO (booth level officer)
K-ELEC-09.answer: You can find your BLO's details on the Voters' Service Portal or electoral search site. You can also use 'Book-a-Call with BLO' in the ECINET app, or call 1950.
K-ELEC-09.check_note: ECI VSP page: BLO details searchable; PIB: 'Book-a-Call with BLO' on ECINET and 1950 helpline for queries.

K-ELEC-10.title: Help for voters with disabilities and seniors
K-ELEC-10.who_its_for: Voters with disabilities and senior citizens
K-ELEC-10.answer: Polling booths are meant to be accessible, and voters with disabilities can ask for help such as a wheelchair. The Saksham service is now part of the ECINET app, or you can call 1950.
K-ELEC-10.check_note: PIB: Saksham (PwD requests, wheelchair) now merged into ECINET app. Specific booth facilities (ramps, volunteers) not confirmed on this page.

K-ELEC-11.title: Report election code violations (cVIGIL)
K-ELEC-11.answer: During elections, you can report bribery, illegal posters or other code violations with a photo or video on cVIGIL, now available in the ECINET app. Officials aim to update you on action within 100 minutes.
K-ELEC-11.check_note: ECI cVIGIL page; PIB: cVIGIL integrated into ECINET app, status update promised within 100 minutes.

K-ELEC-12.title: Know your candidate
K-ELEC-12.answer: You can see candidates' criminal cases, assets, education and full affidavits in the Know Your Candidate section of the ECINET app.
K-ELEC-12.check_note: PIB 2026: Know Your Candidate module in ECINET shows criminal cases, assets, education and full Form 26 affidavit.

K-ELEC-13.title: Booth change announcement
K-ELEC-13.answer: If a booth changes, the agent should read the new booth only from the current official roll or notice.

K-ELEC-14.title: First-time voter awareness
K-ELEC-14.answer: Check your name on the roll well before polling day, and register in advance against the next qualifying date if you're turning 18.

K-ELEC-15.title: Can I vote if my name isn't on the roll?
K-ELEC-15.answer: No. Only people whose names are on the electoral roll can vote, even with a voter ID card. Check early and register if missing.
K-ELEC-15.check_note: PIB/ECI: only electors registered in the roll can vote using EPIC or alternative IDs.

K-ELEC-16.title: Postal ballot for eligible voters
K-ELEC-16.who_its_for: Service voters, some seniors and voters with disabilities
K-ELEC-16.answer: Voters above 85 and voters with disabilities marked on the roll can vote from home by postal ballot. Apply in Form 12D through your BLO within 5 days of the election being notified. Service voters and some essential-services staff can also use postal ballots.
K-ELEC-16.check_note: PIB 2026: electors above 85 and flagged PwD can vote by postal ballot at home via Form 12D through BLO within 5 days of notification; essential services too.

K-ELEC-17.title: Track Form 6/7/8 status
K-ELEC-17.answer: You can track your voter form online with its reference number on the Voters' Service Portal or the ECINET app.
K-ELEC-17.check_note: ECI VSP page and PIB 2026: 'Track Your Application' on Voters' Service Portal and ECINET.

K-ELEC-18.title: Is polling day a holiday?
K-ELEC-18.answer: Yes. If you are a voter in that area, your employer must give you a paid holiday on polling day, with no cut in wages. This includes daily-wage and casual workers.
K-ELEC-18.check_note: PIB 2026: Sec 135B RP Act - paid holiday on poll day, no wage cut, includes daily-wage and casual workers; employer fined if violated.

K-ELEC-19.title: Link Aadhaar with voter ID (optional)
K-ELEC-19.answer: Voters may voluntarily link Aadhaar with their EPIC using Form 6B.
K-ELEC-19.check_note: ECI forms page: Form 6B - letter of information of Aadhaar number for roll authentication (voluntary).

K-ELEC-20.title: Shift address within the same constituency
K-ELEC-20.answer: Use Form 8 for a change of address within or outside the constituency (earlier Form 8A).
K-ELEC-20.check_note: ECI Form 8 guidelines: Form 8 covers shifting of residence (forms revised from 1 Aug 2022; old Form 8A merged).

K-DISA-01.title: Heatwave: stay safe
K-DISA-01.who_its_for: Everyone, especially elderly, children and outdoor workers
K-DISA-01.answer: Drink water often, avoid going out in the hottest part of the day (around 12–3 pm), wear light cotton clothes, and get help fast for dizziness, confusion or no sweating.
K-DISA-01.check_note: NDMA heat wave do's & don'ts: drink water often, avoid sun 12 noon-3 pm, light loose cotton clothes.

K-DISA-02.title: Heavy rain and flood: what to do
K-DISA-02.answer: Move to higher ground, keep documents and medicines in a waterproof bag, don't walk or drive through flood water, and follow official alerts.
K-DISA-02.check_note: NDMA flood pages: move to higher ground, documents in waterproof bags, don't walk or drive through flood water, follow official advice.

K-DISA-03.title: Cyclone warning
K-DISA-03.answer: Fishers shouldn't go to sea. Secure loose items, keep a torch and charged phone, and move to a shelter if told.
K-DISA-03.check_note: NDMA cyclone advice (torch, safety kit, shelter on evacuation) and IMD bulletins advising fishermen not to venture into sea.

K-DISA-04.title: Lightning safety
K-DISA-04.answer: Go indoors when you hear thunder. If caught outside, avoid trees and open fields and crouch low. Lightning alerts are on the Damini app.
K-DISA-04.check_note: NDMA lightning page (stay indoors when thunder heard, don't lie flat); PIB: Damini app by IITM gives location-specific lightning alerts.

K-DISA-05.title: Earthquake safety
K-DISA-05.answer: Drop, cover and hold on. Stay away from windows; after shaking stops, go to an open area.
K-DISA-05.check_note: NDMA earthquake do's & don'ts: drop, cover, hold on; stay away from glass/windows; go out only once shaking stops.

K-DISA-06.title: Landslide warning
K-DISA-06.who_its_for: People in hilly areas (e.g. Kodagu, Western Ghats)
K-DISA-06.answer: During heavy rain, move away from steep slopes and follow evacuation orders.
K-DISA-06.check_note: NDMA landslide do's & don'ts: move away from landslide path quickly, follow weather advisories, go to shelters.

K-DISA-07.title: Find a relief camp or shelter
K-DISA-07.answer: The district control room can tell you the nearest relief camp with food, water and first aid.
K-DISA-07.check_note: KSDMA district plans list 1077 as district emergency operation centre toll-free; relief camp info via that number not explicitly stated.

K-DISA-08.title: District disaster control room
K-DISA-08.answer: Call 1077 to reach your district disaster control room for rescue, relief and information. In Karnataka, the state emergency operation centre is on 1070.
K-DISA-08.check_note: KSDMA district plans: DEOC toll-free 1077. Karnataka Revenue Dept: State Emergency Operation Centre 1070.

K-DISA-09.title: Compensation for house damage
K-DISA-09.answer: Families can get relief money for damaged houses after an official survey, at rates set under disaster relief norms.
K-DISA-09.steps: 1. Report damage to the village accountant or taluk office. 2. Survey. 3. Money to bank.
K-DISA-09.check_note: MHA SDRF items & norms confirm house damage relief at notified rates; Karnataka revises its own rates by order (KSDMA). Steps/office not confirmed.

K-DISA-10.title: Compensation for crop loss in disaster
K-DISA-10.answer: If a notified disaster damages 33% or more of your crop, you can get input subsidy after a joint survey by revenue and agriculture officials. This is separate from any crop insurance claim.
K-DISA-10.steps: 1. Report to agriculture office or village accountant. 2. Survey. 3. Money to bank.
K-DISA-10.check_note: PIB: SDRF input subsidy paid only where crop loss is 33% or more, after joint Revenue-Agriculture field survey.

K-DISA-11.title: Ex gratia for loss of life or livestock
K-DISA-11.who_its_for: Families who lost a member or animals
K-DISA-11.answer: Under national disaster relief norms, the family of a person who died in a disaster gets ex gratia of ₹4 lakh. There is also help for loss of livestock. Contact your taluk office.
K-DISA-11.documents: Death certificate or vet certificate; ID
K-DISA-11.check_note: MHA SDRF norms/Rajya Sabha reply: ex gratia Rs 4 lakh per deceased person; livestock loss assistance per norms.

K-DISA-12.title: Get official alerts on your phone (Sachet)
K-DISA-12.answer: Official weather and disaster alerts for your area come by SMS from a sender ending in NDMAEW, and on the Sachet app. You can also add other locations in the app.
K-DISA-12.check_note: Sachet portal: area-specific alerts by SMS (header XX-NDMAEW) and Sachet app; PIB: cell broadcast alerts also being added.

K-DISA-13.title: Weather forecast and warnings
K-DISA-13.answer: District-wise forecasts and colour-coded warnings are published by IMD.
K-DISA-13.check_note: IMD site publishes district-wise and sub-division-wise warnings and nowcasts; PIB: Mausam app for forecasts and warnings.

K-DISA-14.title: Prepare an emergency kit
K-DISA-14.answer: Keep water, dry food, medicines, torch, power bank, copies of documents and some cash ready.
K-DISA-14.check_note: NDMA flood/urban flood pages list kit: dry food, water, torch, medicines, first aid, documents. Power bank and cash not explicitly listed.

K-DISA-15.title: After a flood: health
K-DISA-15.answer: Drink boiled or chlorinated water, avoid wading in flood water with cuts, and watch for fever, diarrhoea and skin infections.
K-DISA-15.check_note: NDMA urban flood and biological do's & don'ts: drink boiled/chlorinated water, avoid contact with flood water, watch for diarrhoeal disease.

K-DISA-16.title: Report a fallen tree or blocked road
K-DISA-16.answer: In Bengaluru, report fallen trees or blocked roads to the Greater Bengaluru Authority helpline 1533 or on Sahaaya. For fallen power lines, call BESCOM on 1912. Outside Bengaluru, call 1077.
K-DISA-16.check_note: GBA site: 24x7 civic helpline 1533 and Sahaaya complaints for Bengaluru. Tree/road handling specifics not stated on page.

K-DISA-18.title: Drought: water saving
K-DISA-18.answer: Use water carefully, report drinking water shortage to the panchayat, and follow water supply schedules.
K-DISA-18.check_note: NDMA drought do's & don'ts: judicious use, don't waste drinking water. Reporting shortage to gram panchayat not confirmed.

K-DISA-19.title: Official alert announcement
K-DISA-19.answer: The agent reads only the current official alert: area, time, what to do and who to call.

K-DISA-20.title: Volunteer for disaster response (Aapda Mitra)
K-DISA-20.answer: Aapda Mitra trains community volunteers to help during disasters. In Karnataka, 11 districts including Bengaluru Urban are covered. To volunteer, contact your district disaster management authority at the Deputy Commissioner's office.
K-DISA-20.check_note: NDMA Aapda Mitra site: Karnataka SDMA trained 3,400 volunteers in 11 districts incl. Bengaluru Urban (500); ~1 lakh nationally (PIB).

F-POLI-CYBER.name: Money lost to fraud
F-POLI-CYBER.starts_when: Caller lost money online or on a call

steps.question: Did you lose money?

then.text: Report the number on Chakshu → K-POLI-04 (Report suspicious calls and messages (Chakshu)); end

steps.question: When did it happen?
(Agent) Please call 1930 right now — the sooner, the better the chance of stopping the money. Then report on cybercrime.gov.in and tell your bank.

then.text: → K-POLI-02 (Lost money to cyber fraud: what to do)

steps.question: Did you share an OTP or PIN with anyone?

then.text: Tell the bank to block the card/account now

steps.question: Have you filed a police report or e-Lost report?

then.text: File it first → K-POLI-07 (Report a lost document)

steps.question: Have you got a duplicate SIM for that number?

then.text: Get it from your mobile operator first

steps.question: (Agent) Now block the phone on Sanchar Saathi with the report.

then.text: → K-POLI-03 (Block a lost or stolen phone (CEIR))

steps.question: How were you treated at the police station, from 1 to 5?
Was your complaint taken the same day?
Were you asked for any money?

then.text: Record as urgent issue

steps.question: How old are you?

then.text: Not yet eligible; end

steps.question: Which vehicle: gearless scooter, motorcycle with gear, car, or transport vehicle?
steps.if_answer: Age below the limit for that vehicle

then.text: 16+ gearless, 18+ geared bike or car, 20+ transport; end

steps.question: Do you have age and address proof and a photo?

then.text: Say what's needed

steps.question: (Agent) Apply on Sarathi, pay the fee and take the test. It's valid for 6 months.

then.text: → K-TRAN-01 (Learner's licence)

F-TRAN-DL.name: Driving licence
F-TRAN-DL.starts_when: Caller wants a permanent licence or renewal

steps.question: Is this a new licence or a renewal?

then.text: Go to step 3

steps.question: Have you had your learner's licence for at least 30 days?

then.text: Wait until 30 days; end

steps.question: (Renewal) Are you 40 or older?

then.text: A Form 1A medical certificate is needed → K-TRAN-04 (Renew a driving licence)

F-TRAN-BUS.name: Bus complaint

F-LABO-RURALJOB.name: Rural job guarantee

F-LABO-PMSYM.name: Pension for unorganised workers

steps.question: Is your monthly income ₹15,000 or less?

then.text: Not eligible

F-WELF-OAP.name: Old-age pension (Karnataka)
F-WELF-OAP.starts_when: Caller asks about an old-age pension

steps.question: How old is the person?

then.text: Not yet eligible; end

steps.question: Is the family poor (BPL)?

then.text: Not eligible for this pension

F-WELF-RATION.name: Ration card
F-WELF-RATION.starts_when: Caller asks about a ration card

steps.question: Do you need a new card, or to add someone to an existing card?

then.text: New applications are only being processed if filed before March 2023 → K-WELF-04 (New ration card or adding a member (Karnataka)); end

steps.question: Do all family members have Aadhaar?

then.text: Needed for every member

steps.question: (Agent) Apply on the Ahara portal or at a Grama One or Bangalore One centre.
Is the woman named as head of the family on the ration card?

then.text: Only the woman head can get it

steps.question: Has she registered on Seva Sindhu?

then.text: → K-WELF-06 (Gruha Lakshmi (Karnataka)) steps

steps.question: Has a payment been missed?

then.text: → K-WELF-07 (My Gruha Lakshmi money didn't come)

steps.question: Did you receive your pension this month?

then.text: Record as urgent issue

steps.question: How much did you receive, as you remember it?
Did you face any problem collecting it?

then.text: Record details

F-ELEC-REGISTER.name: Become a voter
F-ELEC-REGISTER.starts_when: Caller asks how to register or update voter details

steps.question: Are you 18, or will you turn 18 by the next qualifying date (1 Jan, 1 Apr, 1 Jul or 1 Oct)?

then.text: Not yet eligible; end

steps.question: Is your name already on the voter list?

then.text: Check on electoral search or SMS 1950

steps.question: Do you need to register, correct details or change address?

then.text: Form 8 → K-ELEC-02 (Correct details or change address (Form 8)); end

steps.question: (Agent) Fill Form 6 online or on the app; the BLO will verify.

then.text: → K-ELEC-01 (Register as a new voter (Form 6))

steps.question: Do you have your voter ID (EPIC) number?

then.text: Search by name on electoral search

steps.question: (Agent) SMS 'ECIPS' and your EPIC number to 1950, or search online.

then.text: → K-ELEC-03 (Where is my polling booth?)

steps.question: Is the voter above 85, or a person with a disability marked on the roll?

then.text: Not eligible for home voting; end

steps.question: (Agent) Apply in Form 12D through your BLO within 5 days of the election being notified.

then.text: → K-ELEC-16 (Postal ballot for eligible voters)

steps.question: Do you need help reaching a shelter?

F-DISA-DAMAGE.name: Report damage

steps.question: What was damaged: house, crop or livestock?

then.text: Crop → K-DISA-10 (Compensation for crop loss in disaster); house → K-DISA-09 (Compensation for house damage)

guardrails.rule: Say it is an AI assistant at the start of every call.
guardrails.what_the_agent_says: I'm an AI assistant for the {sector} department.

guardrails.rule: Say this is a demo with sample information.
guardrails.what_the_agent_says: This is a demo call, so some details are sample information.

guardrails.rule: Never ask for Aadhaar, bank account, card numbers, OTPs or passwords.
guardrails.what_the_agent_says: I won't ask for your Aadhaar, bank details or any OTP. Please don't share them on this call.

guardrails.rule: Answer only from the Knowledge tab. If there is no matching row, say so and give the helpline.
guardrails.what_the_agent_says: I don't have that information. You can call {helpline} for help.
This sounds like an emergency. Please call 112 now.

guardrails.rule: If someone sounds distressed, be calm, slow down, and offer a person or helpline.
guardrails.what_the_agent_says: I'm sorry you're going through this. Would you like the number for someone who can help?

guardrails.rule: Do not repeat or keep personal details a tester volunteers.
guardrails.what_the_agent_says: Thank you. I don't need those details for this demo.

guardrails.rule: Speak simply, one idea at a time, repeat when asked, and confirm by reading back.
guardrails.what_the_agent_says: Let me repeat that so you have it…

guardrails.rule: Always give a reference number and the expected time for action.

guardrails.rule: Ask if it is a good time; offer to call back.

guardrails.rule: Ask one question per turn, then stop and wait for the answer. Never list several questions. Repeat short answers back before moving on. Follow the matching flow in the Question flows tab, and skip any step the caller has already answered.
